def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    idx = 0
    N = int(data[idx])
    idx +=1
    Q = int(data[idx])
    idx +=1
    a = list(map(int, data[idx:idx+N]))
    idx +=N
    a = [x % MOD for x in a]

    # Pre-allocate the segment tree arrays
    size = 1
    while size < N:
        size <<= 1
    max_nodes = 4 * N  # Adjust based on possible node indices
    sum_tree = [0] * (4 * N)
    B_tree = [1] * (4 * N)
    C_tree = [0] * (4 * N)

    def build(node, start, end):
        B_tree[node] = 1
        C_tree[node] = 0
        if start + 1 == end:
            sum_tree[node] = a[start] if start < N else 0
            return
        mid = (start + end) // 2
        build(2*node, start, mid)
        build(2*node+1, mid, end)
        sum_tree[node] = (sum_tree[2*node] + sum_tree[2*node+1]) % MOD

    build(1, 0, N)

    for _ in range(Q):
        query_type = int(data[idx])
        idx +=1
        if query_type == 0:
            l = int(data[idx])
            idx +=1
            r = int(data[idx])
            idx +=1
            b = int(data[idx]) % MOD
            idx +=1
            c = int(data[idx]) % MOD
            idx +=1

            def update(node, node_start, node_end):
                if r <= node_start or node_end <= l:
                    return
                if l <= node_start and node_end <= r:
                    sum_tree[node] = (b * sum_tree[node] + c * (node_end - node_start)) % MOD
                    B_tree[node] = (B_tree[node] * b) % MOD
                    C_tree[node] = (C_tree[node] * b + c) % MOD
                    return
                if B_tree[node] != 1 or C_tree[node] != 0:
                    mid_curr = (node_start + node_end) // 2
                    left = 2 * node
                    right_child = 2 * node + 1

                    sum_left = (B_tree[node] * sum_tree[left] + C_tree[node] * (mid_curr - node_start)) % MOD
                    B_left = (B_tree[left] * B_tree[node]) % MOD
                    C_left = (C_tree[left] * B_tree[node] + C_tree[node]) % MOD
                    sum_tree[left] = sum_left
                    B_tree[left] = B_left
                    C_tree[left] = C_left

                    sum_right = (B_tree[node] * sum_tree[right_child] + C_tree[node] * (node_end - mid_curr)) % MOD
                    B_right = (B_tree[right_child] * B_tree[node]) % MOD
                    C_right = (C_tree[right_child] * B_tree[node] + C_tree[node]) % MOD
                    sum_tree[right_child] = sum_right
                    B_tree[right_child] = B_right
                    C_tree[right_child] = C_right

                    B_tree[node] = 1
                    C_tree[node] = 0
                mid = (node_start + node_end) // 2
                update(2*node, node_start, mid)
                update(2*node+1, mid, node_end)
                sum_tree[node] = (sum_tree[2*node] + sum_tree[2*node+1]) % MOD
            update(1, 0, N)
        else:
            l = int(data[idx])
            idx +=1
            r = int(data[idx])
            idx +=1

            def query(node, node_start, node_end):
                if r <= node_start or node_end <= l:
                    return 0
                if l <= node_start and node_end <= r:
                    return sum_tree[node]
                if B_tree[node] != 1 or C_tree[node] != 0:
                    mid_curr = (node_start + node_end) // 2
                    left = 2 * node
                    right_child = 2 * node + 1

                    sum_left = (B_tree[node] * sum_tree[left] + C_tree[node] * (mid_curr - node_start)) % MOD
                    B_left = (B_tree[left] * B_tree[node]) % MOD
                    C_left = (C_tree[left] * B_tree[node] + C_tree[node]) % MOD
                    sum_tree[left] = sum_left
                    B_tree[left] = B_left
                    C_tree[left] = C_left

                    sum_right = (B_tree[node] * sum_tree[right_child] + C_tree[node] * (node_end - mid_curr)) % MOD
                    B_right = (B_tree[right_child] * B_tree[node]) % MOD
                    C_right = (C_tree[right_child] * B_tree[node] + C_tree[node]) % MOD
                    sum_tree[right_child] = sum_right
                    B_tree[right_child] = B_right
                    C_tree[right_child] = C_right

                    B_tree[node] = 1
                    C_tree[node] = 0
                mid = (node_start + node_end) // 2
                left_sum = query(2*node, node_start, mid)
                right_sum = query(2*node+1, mid, node_end)
                return (left_sum + right_sum) % MOD
            res = query(1, 0, N)
            print(res % MOD)

import sys
MOD = 10**9 + 7
BASE = 911382629

def get_divisors(n):
    divisors = set()
    for i in range(1, int(n**0.5) + 1):
        if n % i == 0:
            divisors.add(i)
            divisors.add(n // i)
    return sorted(divisors)

class SegmentTree:
    def __init__(self, data, base, mod):
        self.n = len(data)
        self.base = base
        self.mod = mod
        self.size = 1
        while self.size < self.n:
            self.size <<= 1
        self.tree_hash = [0] * (2 * self.size)
        self.tree_len = [0] * (2 * self.size)
        self.pow_base = [1] * (self.n + 1)
        for i in range(1, self.n + 1):
            self.pow_base[i] = (self.pow_base[i-1] * self.base) % self.mod
        for i in range(self.n):
            self.tree_hash[self.size + i] = ord(data[i]) % mod
            self.tree_len[self.size + i] = 1
        for i in range(self.size -1, 0, -1):
            left = 2 * i
            right = 2 * i +1
            self.tree_len[i] = self.tree_len[left] + self.tree_len[right]
            self.tree_hash[i] = (self.tree_hash[left] * self.pow_base[self.tree_len[right]] + self.tree_hash[right]) % mod
    
    def update(self, pos, char_val):
        pos += self.size
        self.tree_hash[pos] = char_val % self.mod
        pos >>= 1
        while pos >= 1:
            left = 2 * pos
            right = 2 * pos +1
            self.tree_hash[pos] = (self.tree_hash[left] * self.pow_base[self.tree_len[right]] + self.tree_hash[right]) % self.mod
            pos >>= 1
    
    def get_full_hash(self):
        return self.tree_hash[1]
    
    def query_hash(self, l, r):
        res_hash = 0
        res_len = 0
        l += self.size
        r += self.size
        stack = []
        while l <= r:
            if l % 2 == 1:
                stack.append((self.tree_hash[l], self.tree_len[l]))
                l += 1
            if r % 2 == 0:
                stack.append((self.tree_hash[r], self.tree_len[r]))
                r -= 1
            l >>= 1
            r >>= 1
        for h, ln in reversed(stack):
            res_hash = (res_hash * self.pow_base[ln] + h) % self.mod
            res_len += ln
        return res_hash

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()

            s = m % MOD

            s = (pow(r, m, MOD) -1) * pow(r-1, MOD-2, MOD) % MOD

        p = int(input[ptr]) -1

        c = input[ptr]

                continue
            if d ==0:
                continue
            h_d = st.query_hash(0, d-1)
            expected = (h_d * sum_d[d]) % MOD
            if expected == hash_all:
                print(d)

import sys
from collections import defaultdict

def is_leap_year(year):
    if year % 400 == 0:
        return True
    if year % 100 == 0:
        return False
    if year % 4 == 0:
        return True
    return False

digit_segments = [
    {0,1,2,4,5,6},  # 0
    {2,5},           # 1
    {0,2,3,4,6},     # 2
    {0,2,3,5,6},     # 3
    {1,2,3,5},       #4
    {0,1,3,5,6},     #5
    {0,1,3,4,5,6},   #6
    {0,2,5},         #7

    {0,1,2,3,5,6},   #9

def main():
    N = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    K = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    broken = [set() for _ in range(14)]
    for _ in range(K):
        p, q = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
        broken[p].add(q)
    
    # Precompute digit_segment_counts
    digit_segment_counts = [[0]*10 for _ in range(14)]
    for p in range(14):
        for d in range(10):
            segs = digit_segments[d].difference(broken[p])
            digit_segment_counts[p][d] = len(segs)
    
    # Compute date counts
    date_counts = defaultdict(int)
    for year in range(10000):
        y0 = year // 1000
        y1 = (year // 100) % 10
        y2 = (year // 10) % 10
        y3 = year % 10
        sum_yyyy = (digit_segment_counts[0][y0] + digit_segment_counts[1][y1] +
                    digit_segment_counts[2][y2] + digit_segment_counts[3][y3])
        
        for month in range(1, 13):
            m0, m1 = divmod(month, 10)
            sum_mm = digit_segment_counts[4][m0] + digit_segment_counts[5][m1]
            
            if month in (4,6,9,11):
                dim = 30
            elif month == 2:
                dim = 29 if is_leap_year(year) else 28
            else:
                dim = 31
            
            for day in range(1, dim + 1):
                d0, d1 = divmod(day, 10)
                sum_dd = digit_segment_counts[6][d0] + digit_segment_counts[7][d1]
                total = sum_yyyy + sum_mm + sum_dd
                date_counts[total] += 1
    
    # Compute time counts
    time_counts = defaultdict(int)
    for hour in range(24):
        h0, h1 = divmod(hour, 10)
        sum_hh = digit_segment_counts[8][h0] + digit_segment_counts[9][h1]
        
        for minute in range(60):
            m0, m1 = divmod(minute, 10)
            sum_mm = digit_segment_counts[10][m0] + digit_segment_counts[11][m1]
            
            for second in range(60):
                s0, s1 = divmod(second, 10)
                sum_ss = digit_segment_counts[12][s0] + digit_segment_counts[13][s1]
                total = sum_hh + sum_mm + sum_ss
                time_counts[total] += 1
    
    # Calculate the result
    result = 0
    for s in date_counts:
        t = N - s
        if t in time_counts:
            result += date_counts[s] * time_counts[t]
    print(result)

import sys
MOD = 998244353

def main():
    sys.setrecursionlimit(1 << 25)
    n, q = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    edges = [[] for _ in range(n+1)]
    for _ in range(n-1):
        u, v = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
        edges[u].append(v)
        edges[v].append(u)
    
    # Preprocess in_time, out_time, parent, children, s (subtree size)
    in_time = [0] * (n + 1)
    out_time = [0] * (n + 1)
    parent = [0] * (n + 1)
    children = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
    s = [1] * (n + 1)
    time = 1
    stack = [(1, -1, False)]
    
    while stack:
        u, p, visited = stack.pop()
        if visited:
            for v in edges[u]:
                if v != p:
                    s[u] += s[v]
            out_time[u] = time - 1
            continue
        parent[u] = p
        in_time[u] = time
        time += 1
        stack.append((u, p, True))
        for v in edges[u]:
            if v != p:
                stack.append((v, u, False))
                children[u].append(v)
    
    inv_n = pow(n, MOD-2, MOD)
    
    # Fenwick Tree implementation for range add and point query
    class FenwickTree:
        def __init__(self, size):
            self.N = size
            self.tree = [0] * (self.N + 2)
        
        def add(self, idx, delta):
            while idx <= self.N:
                self.tree[idx] = (self.tree[idx] + delta) % MOD
                idx += idx & -idx
        
        def query(self, idx):
            res = 0
            while idx > 0:
                res = (res + self.tree[idx]) % MOD
                idx -= idx & -idx
            return res
    
    max_time = n
    fenwick = FenwickTree(max_time)
    global_sum = 0
    
    for _ in range(q):
        parts = sys.stdin.readline().split()
        if not parts:
            continue
        if parts[0] == '1':
            v = int(parts[1])
            d = int(parts[2])
            term_global = (d % MOD) * s[v] % MOD
            term_global = term_global * inv_n % MOD
            global_sum = (global_sum + term_global) % MOD
            for c in children[v]:
                term = (d % MOD) * s[c] % MOD
                term = term * inv_n % MOD
                l = in_time[c]
                r = out_time[c]
                fenwick.add(l, term)
                fenwick.add(r + 1, (-term) % MOD)
        else:
            v = int(parts[1])
            it = in_time[v]
            sub = fenwick.query(it)
            res = (global_sum - sub) % MOD

import sys
from collections import deque

def main():
    while True:
        line = sys.stdin.readline()
        if not line:
            break
        w, h = map(int, line.strip().split())
        if w == 0 and h == 0:
            break
        grid = []
        start = None
        goal = None
        blocks = []
        for y in range(h):
            row = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()))
            grid.append(row)
            for x, val in enumerate(row):
                if val == 2:
                    start = (x, y)
                elif val == 3:
                    goal = (x, y)
                elif val == 1:
                    blocks.append((x, y))
        if not start or not goal:
            print(-1)
            continue
        block_indices = {pos: idx for idx, pos in enumerate(blocks)}
        num_blocks = len(blocks)
        directions = [(0, 1), (0, -1), (1, 0), (-1, 0)]
        visited = {}
        q = deque()
        initial_mask = 0
        q.append((start[0], start[1], initial_mask, 0))
        visited_key = (start[0], start[1], initial_mask)
        visited[visited_key] = 0
        found = False
        answer = -1
        while q and not found:
            x, y, mask, steps = q.popleft()
            if steps >= 10:
                continue
            for dx, dy in directions:
                current_x, current_y = x, y
                new_x, new_y = None, None
                new_mask = mask
                reached_goal = False
                while True:
                    next_x = current_x + dx
                    next_y = current_y + dy
                    if next_x < 0 or next_x >= w or next_y < 0 or next_y >= h:
                        break
                    if (next_x, next_y) == goal:
                        answer = steps + 1
                        found = True
                        break
                    cell = grid[next_y][next_x]
                    if cell == 1 and (next_x, next_y) in block_indices:
                        block_idx = block_indices[(next_x, next_y)]
                        if not (mask & (1 << block_idx)):
                            new_mask = mask | (1 << block_idx)
                            new_x, new_y = current_x, current_y
                            break
                        else:
                            current_x, current_y = next_x, next_y
                    else:
                        current_x, current_y = next_x, next_y
                if found:
                    break
                if new_x is not None:
                    next_steps = steps + 1
                    if next_steps > 10:
                        continue
                    state = (new_x, new_y, new_mask)
                    if state not in visited or visited[state] > next_steps:
                        visited[state] = next_steps
                        q.append((new_x, new_y, new_mask, next_steps))
            if found:
                break
        print(answer if found else -1)

if __name__ == "__main__":

import sys
from collections import deque

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    n = len(s)
    if n == 0:
        return
    
    # Precompute min_steps[x][y][a][b]
    min_steps = [[[[-1 for _ in range(10)] for __ in range(10)] for ___ in range(10)] for ____ in range(10)]
    
    for x in range(10):
        for y in range(10):
            for a in range(10):
                visited = [False] * 10
                queue = deque()
                queue.append((a, 0))
                visited[a] = True
                min_steps[x][y][a][a] = 0
                while queue:
                    current, steps = queue.popleft()
                    # Next steps by adding x
                    next_d = (current + x) % 10
                    if not visited[next_d]:
                        visited[next_d] = True
                        min_steps[x][y][a][next_d] = steps + 1
                        queue.append((next_d, steps + 1))
                    # Next steps by adding y
                    next_d = (current + y) % 10
                    if not visited[next_d]:
                        visited[next_d] = True
                        min_steps[x][y][a][next_d] = steps + 1
                        queue.append((next_d, steps + 1))
    
    result = [[-1 for _ in range(10)] for __ in range(10)]
    
    for x in range(10):
        for y in range(10):
            total = 0
            possible = True
            for i in range(n - 1):
                a = int(s[i])
                b = int(s[i+1])
                steps = min_steps[x][y][a][b]
                if steps == -1:
                    possible = False
                    break
                total += (steps - 1)
            if possible:
                result[x][y] = total
            else:
                result[x][y] = -1
    
    for row in result:
        print(' '.join(map(str, row)))

if __name__ == "__main__":

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    t = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))
    available = defaultdict(int)
    available[0] = 1
    rooms = 1
    for i in range(1, n + 1):

        if available[current_t] > 0:

def main():
    import sys
    n, k = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())

    # Find minimal m where m! >=k
    fact = 1
    m = 1
    while fact < k:
        m += 1
        next_fact = fact * m
        if next_fact < fact:  # Overflow check (unlikely in given constraints)
            break
        fact = next_fact

    if m > n:
        print(-1)
        return

    # Calculate count of lucky numbers in the first part (1..n-m)
    def count_lucky(x):
        if x < 4:
            return 0
        from collections import deque
        q = deque([4, 7])
        cnt = 0
        while q:
            num = q.popleft()
            if num <= x:
                cnt += 1
                q.append(num * 10 + 4)
                q.append(num * 10 + 7)
        return cnt

    count1 = count_lucky(n - m) if (n - m) >= 0 else 0

    # Generate the k-th permutation of the last m elements
    def get_perm(elements, k):
        from math import factorial
        k -= 1  # Convert to 0-based index
        perm = []
        elements = list(elements)
        size = len(elements)
        for i in range(size):
            fact = factorial(size - i - 1)
            idx = k // fact
            k = k % fact
            perm.append(elements.pop(idx))
        return perm

    start = n - m + 1
    elements = list(range(start, n + 1))
    perm = get_perm(elements, k)

    # Check lucky indexes and values in the permutation part
    def is_lucky(num):
        s = str(num)
        return all(c in {'4', '7'} for c in s)

    count2 = 0
    for j in range(m):
        index = start + j
        num = perm[j]
        if is_lucky(index) and is_lucky(num):
            count2 += 1

    print(count1 + count2)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()<#sep#>-

MOD = 10**9 + 7

def multiply(m1, m2, mod):
    a, b, c, d = m1
    e, f, g, h = m2
    new_a = (a * e + b * g) % mod
    new_b = (a * f + b * h) % mod
    new_c = (c * e + d * g) % mod
    new_d = (c * f + d * h) % mod
    return (new_a, new_b, new_c, new_d)

def matrix_power(mat, power, mod):
    result = (1, 0, 0, 1)  # Identity matrix
    while power > 0:
        if power % 2 == 1:
            result = multiply(result, mat, mod)
        mat = multiply(mat, mat, mod)
        power = power // 2
    return result

import bisect

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    idx = 0
    T = int(data[idx])
    idx += 1
    for _ in range(T):
        N, K = int(data[idx]), int(data[idx+1])
        idx +=2
        arr = list(map(int, data[idx:idx+N]))
        idx +=N
        arr.sort()
        min_diff = float('inf')
        i = 0
        j = N -1
        while i < j:
            current_sum = arr[i] + arr[j]
            current_diff = abs(current_sum - K)
            if current_diff < min_diff:
                min_diff = current_diff
            if current_sum < K:
                i +=1
            else:
                j -=1
        count =0
        for i in range(N):
            target1 = (K - min_diff) - arr[i]
            target2 = (K + min_diff) - arr[i]
            left = i +1
            right = N
            if target1 == target2:
                l = bisect.bisect_left(arr, target1, left, right)
                r = bisect.bisect_right(arr, target1, left, right)
                count += (r - l)
            else:
                l = bisect.bisect_left(arr, target1, left, right)
                r = bisect.bisect_right(arr, target1, left, right)
                count += (r - l)
                l = bisect.bisect_left(arr, target2, left, right)
                r = bisect.bisect_right(arr, target2, left, right)
                count += (r - l)
        print(min_diff, count)

def sum_even_fibonacci(n):
    a, b = 2, 8
    total = 0
    if a <= n:
        total += a
    if b <= n:
        total += b
    while True:
        c = 4 * b + a
        if c > n:
            break
        total += c
        a, b = b, c
    return total

import math

def min_days(N):
    k = math.isqrt(N)
    if k * k == N:
        return 2 * k - 1
    else:
        d = N - k * k
        return 2 * k + 1 if d > k else 2 * k

        fact[i] = fact[i-1] * i % MOD
    inv_fact = [1] * (max_fact + 1)
    inv_fact[max_fact] = pow(fact[max_fact], MOD-2, MOD)
    for i in range(max_fact-1, -1, -1):
        inv_fact[i] = inv_fact[i+1] * (i+1) % MOD
    
    def comb(n, k):
        if k < 0 or k > n:
            return 0
        return fact[n] * inv_fact[k] % MOD * inv_fact[n - k] % MOD
    
    pow_c = (k - 2) % MOD
    pow_cache = [1] * (t + 1)
    for i in range(1, t + 1):
        pow_cache[i] = pow_cache[i-1] * pow_c % MOD
    
    C0 = 0
    max_m = t // 2
    for m in range(0, max_m + 1):
        c2m = comb(t, 2*m)
        cm = comb(2*m, m)
        term = c2m * cm % MOD
        e = t - 2*m
        term = term * pow_cache[e] % MOD
        C0 = (C0 + term) % MOD
    
    kt = pow(k, t, MOD)
    S = (kt - C0) % MOD
    inv2 = (MOD + 1) // 2  # since MOD is odd
    S = S * inv2 % MOD
    m_non_active = n - t
    ans = S * pow(k, m_non_active, MOD) % MOD
    print(ans)

import sys

MOD = 10**9 + 7

def euler_phi(n):
    if n == 1:
        return 1
    result = n
    i = 2
    while i * i <= n:
        if n % i == 0:
            while n % i == 0:
                n //= i
            result -= result // i
        i += 1
    if n > 1:
        result -= result // n
    return result

def main():
    n, k = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    current = n
    steps = 0
    while steps < k and current != 1:
        current = euler_phi(current)
        steps += 1
    print(current % MOD)

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

vector<vector<int>> adj;
vector<int> index, low;
stack<int> st;
vector<bool> is_articulation;
vector<vector<int>> components;
vector<int> in_cycle;
vector<int> cycle_len;
int current_index = 0;

void dfs(int u, int parent = -1) {
    index[u] = low[u] = current_index++;
    int children = 0;
    st.push(u);
    for (int v : adj[u]) {
        if (v == parent) continue;
        if (index[v] == -1) {
            children++;
            dfs(v, u);
            low[u] = min(low[u], low[v]);
            if ((parent == -1 && children > 1) || (parent != -1 && low[v] >= index[u])) {
                is_articulation[u] = true;
                components.push_back({});
                while (true) {
                    int w = st.top(); st.pop();
                    components.back().push_back(w);
                    if (w == v) break;
                }
                components.back().push_back(u);
            }
        } else {
            low[u] = min(low[u], index[v]);
        }
    }
    if (parent == -1 && !components.empty() && components.back().back() != u) {
        components.push_back({u});
        st.pop();
    }
}

vector<vector<int>> block_adj;
vector<int> max_depth;
vector<int> answer;

void compute_depth(int u, int block_id, vector<bool>& visited, const vector<unordered_set<int>>& block_nodes) {
    visited[u] = true;
    int current_max = 0;
    for (int v : adj[u]) {
        if (!block_nodes[block_id].count(v) && !visited[v]) {
            compute_depth(v, block_id, visited, block_nodes);
            current_max = max(current_max, max_depth[v] + 1);
        }
    }
    max_depth[u] = current_max;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    adj.resize(n + 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        adj[u].push_back(v);
        adj[v].push_back(u);
    }

    index.assign(n + 1, -1);
    low.assign(n + 1, -1);
    is_articulation.assign(n + 1, false);
    dfs(1);
    if (!st.empty()) {
        components.push_back({});
        while (!st.empty()) {
            components.back().push_back(st.top());
            st.pop();

    }

    vector<unordered_set<int>> block_nodes(components.size());
    for (int i = 0; i < components.size(); i++) {
        for (int u : components[i]) {
            block_nodes[i].insert(u);
        }

    in_cycle.assign(n + 1, -1);
    cycle_len.clear();
    for (int i = 0; i < components.size(); i++) {
        if (components[i].size() >= 3) {
            for (int u : components[i]) {
                in_cycle[u] = cycle_len.size();
            }
            cycle_len.push_back(components[i].size());
        }
    }

    max_depth.assign(n + 1, 0);
    vector<bool> visited(n + 1, false);
    for (int i = 0; i < components.size(); i++) {
        if (components[i].size() < 3) continue;
        unordered_set<int> component_nodes(components[i].begin(), components[i].end());
        for (int u : components[i]) {
            if (is_articulation[u]) {
                compute_depth(u, i, visited, block_nodes);
            }
        }
    }

    answer.assign(n + 1, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < components.size(); i++) {
        if (components[i].size() < 3) continue;
        int k = components[i].size();
        int radius = (k - 1) / 2;
        vector<int> art_points;
        for (int u : components[i]) {
            if (is_articulation[u]) {
                art_points.push_back(u);
            }
        }
        for (int u : components[i]) {
            int current_max = radius;
            for (int v : art_points) {
                current_max = max(current_max, radius + max_depth[v]);
            }
            answer[u] = current_max;
        }
    }

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (in_cycle[i] == -1) {
            compute_depth(i, -1, visited, block_nodes);
            answer[i] = max_depth[i];
        }
    }

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        cout << answer[i] << (i == n ? '\n' : ' ');
    }

    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    mutable long long val;
    Node(int l_, int r_, long long val_) : l(l_), r(r_), val(val_) {}
    bool operator<(const Node& o) const { return l < o.l; }
};

set<Node> intervals;
using iter = set<Node>::iterator;

iter split(int pos) {
    auto it = intervals.lower_bound(Node(pos, 0, 0));
    if (it != intervals.end() && it->l == pos) return it;
    --it;
    int l = it->l, r = it->r;
    long long v = it->val;
    intervals.erase(it);
    intervals.insert(Node(l, pos, v));
    return intervals.insert(Node(pos, r, v)).first;
}

long long powmod(long long a, long long b, long long mod) {
    a %= mod;
    if (a < 0) a += mod;
    long long res = 1;
    while (b) {
        if (b % 2) res = res * a % mod;
        a = a * a % mod;
        b /= 2;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m, vmax;
    long long seed;
    cin >> n >> m >> seed >> vmax;

    const long long MOD = 1e9 + 7;

    auto rnd = [&]() {
        long long ret = seed;
        seed = (seed * 7 + 13) % MOD;
        return ret;
    };

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        int a = rnd() % vmax + 1;
        intervals.insert(Node(i, i + 1, a));
    }

    while (m--) {
        int op = rnd() % 4 + 1;
        int l = rnd() % n + 1;
        int r = rnd() % n + 1;
        if (l > r) swap(l, r);
        int x, y;

        if (op == 3) {
            x = rnd() % (r - l + 1) + 1;
        } else {
            x = rnd() % vmax + 1;
        }

        if (op == 4) {
            y = rnd() % vmax + 1;
        }

        if (op == 1) {
            auto itr = split(r + 1);
            auto itl = split(l);
            for (auto it = itl; it != itr; ++it) {
                it->val += x;
            }
        } else if (op == 2) {
            auto itr = split(r + 1);
            auto itl = split(l);
            intervals.erase(itl, itr);
            intervals.insert(Node(l, r + 1, x));
        } else if (op == 3) {
            auto itr = split(r + 1);
            auto itl = split(l);
            vector<pair<long long, int>> vec;
            for (auto it = itl; it != itr; ++it) {
                vec.emplace_back(it->val, it->r - it->l);
            }
            sort(vec.begin(), vec.end());
            int rem = x;
            long long ans = 0;
            for (auto& p : vec) {
                if (rem <= p.second) {
                    ans = p.first;
                    break;
                }
                rem -= p.second;
            }
            cout << ans << '\n';
        } else {
            auto itr = split(r + 1);
            auto itl = split(l);
            long long sum = 0;
            for (auto it = itl; it != itr; ++it) {
                long long cnt = it->r - it->l;
                long long val = it->val;
                long long term = (cnt % y) * powmod(val, x, y) % y;
                sum = (sum + term) % y;
            }
            cout << sum % y << '\n';
        }
    }

    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct State {
    int time;
    int floor;
    int next_emp;
    tuple<int, int, int, int> pass;
    
    bool operator>(const State& other) const {
        return time > other.time;
    }
};

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<pair<int, int>> emps(n);
    for (auto& [a, b] : emps) {
        cin >> a >> b;
    }
    
    priority_queue<State, vector<State>, greater<State>> pq;
    map<int, map<int, map<tuple<int, int, int, int>, int>>> dist;
    
    auto initial_pass = make_tuple(0, 0, 0, 0);
    pq.push({0, 1, 0, initial_pass});
    
    int answer = -1;
    
    while (!pq.empty()) {
        State current = pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        
        int time = current.time;
        int floor = current.floor;
        int next_emp = current.next_emp;
        auto pass = current.pass;
        
        if (dist.count(floor) && dist[floor].count(next_emp) && dist[floor][next_emp].count(pass) && dist[floor][next_emp][pass] <= time) {
            continue;
        }
        dist[floor][next_emp][pass] = time;
        
        if (next_emp == n) {
            auto [a, b, c, d] = pass;
            if (a == 0 && b == 0 && c == 0 && d == 0) {
                answer = time;
                break;
            }
        }
        
        // Move up
        if (floor < 9) {
            int new_floor = floor + 1;
            int new_time = time + 1;
            auto new_pass = pass;
            State next = {new_time, new_floor, next_emp, new_pass};
            if (!(dist.count(new_floor) && dist[new_floor].count(next_emp) && dist[new_floor][next_emp].count(new_pass) && dist[new_floor][next_emp][new_pass] <= new_time)) {
                pq.push(next);
            }
        }
        
        // Move down
        if (floor > 1) {
            int new_floor = floor - 1;
            int new_time = time + 1;
            auto new_pass = pass;
            State next = {new_time, new_floor, next_emp, new_pass};
            if (!(dist.count(new_floor) && dist[new_floor].count(next_emp) && dist[new_floor][next_emp].count(new_pass) && dist[new_floor][next_emp][new_pass] <= new_time)) {
                pq.push(next);
            }
        }
        
        // Open door
        auto [a, b, c, d] = pass;
        vector<int> current_pass;
        if (a != 0) current_pass.push_back(a);
        if (b != 0) current_pass.push_back(b);
        if (c != 0) current_pass.push_back(c);
        if (d != 0) current_pass.push_back(d);
        
        int exit_count = 0;
        vector<int> after_exit;
        for (int p : current_pass) {
            if (p == floor) {
                exit_count++;
            } else {
                after_exit.push_back(p);
            }
        }
        sort(after_exit.begin(), after_exit.end());
        
        int load_count = 0;
        int new_next_emp = next_emp;
        vector<int> new_pass_list = after_exit;
        while (new_next_emp < n && new_pass_list.size() < 4) {
            auto [emp_a, emp_b] = emps[new_next_emp];
            if (emp_a == floor) {
                new_pass_list.push_back(emp_b);
                new_next_emp++;
                load_count++;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        sort(new_pass_list.begin(), new_pass_list.end());
        
        tuple<int, int, int, int> new_pass;
        vector<int> padded(4, 0);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < new_pass_list.size() && i < 4; ++i) {
            padded[i] = new_pass_list[i];
        }
        new_pass = make_tuple(padded[0], padded[1], padded[2], padded[3]);
        
        int new_time = time + exit_count + load_count;
        State next = {new_time, floor, new_next_emp, new_pass};
        if (!(dist.count(floor) && dist[floor].count(new_next_emp) && dist[floor][new_next_emp].count(new_pass) && dist[floor][new_next_emp][new_pass] <= new_time)) {
            pq.push(next);
        }
    }
    
    cout << answer << endl;
    
    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Point {
    int x, y;
    Point(int x = 0, int y = 0) : x(x), y(y) {}
    bool operator<(const Point& other) const {
        if (x != other.x) return x < other.x;
        return y < other.y;
    }
    bool operator==(const Point& other) const {
        return x == other.x && y == other.y;
    }
};

namespace std {
    template<> struct hash<Point> {
        size_t operator()(const Point& p) const {
            return hash<int>()(p.x) ^ (hash<int>()(p.y) << 1);
        }
    };
}

struct Triangle {
    Point a, b, c;
    Triangle(Point a = Point(), Point b = Point(), Point c = Point()) : a(a), b(b), c(c) {}
    bool operator==(const Triangle& other) const {
        return a == other.a && b == other.b && c == other.c;
    }
};

vector<Triangle> generate_all_congruent(const Triangle& orig) {
    vector<Point> pts = {orig.a, orig.b, orig.c};
    set<vector<Point>> seen;

    do {
        for (int rot = 0; rot < 4; ++rot) {
            for (int refl = 0; refl < 2; ++refl) {
                vector<Point> t = pts;
                for (int r = 0; r < rot; ++r) {
                    for (auto& p : t) {
                        int nx = -p.y, ny = p.x;
                        p.x = nx;
                        p.y = ny;
                    }
                }
                if (refl) {
                    for (auto& p : t) {
                        p.x = -p.x;
                    }
                }
                seen.insert(t);

                vector<Point> t2 = t;
                for (auto& p : t2) {
                    swap(p.x, p.y);
                    p.y = -p.y;
                }
                seen.insert(t2);
            }
        }
    } while (next_permutation(pts.begin(), pts.end()));

    vector<Triangle> res;
    for (const auto& v : seen) {
        res.emplace_back(v[0], v[1], v[2]);
    }
    return res;
}

vector<Triangle> generate_translations(const Triangle& base) {
    vector<Triangle> res;
    for (int dx = -20; dx <= 40; ++dx) {
        for (int dy = -20; dy <= 40; ++dy) {
            Point a(base.a.x + dx, base.a.y + dy);
            Point b(base.b.x + dx, base.b.y + dy);
            Point c(base.c.x + dx, base.c.y + dy);
            res.emplace_back(a, b, c);
        }
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    vector<Triangle> ships(4);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
        int x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3;
        cin >> x1 >> y1 >> x2 >> y2 >> x3 >> y3;
        ships[i] = Triangle(Point(x1, y1), Point(x2, y2), Point(x3, y3));
    }

    vector<vector<Triangle>> options(4);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
        vector<Triangle> congruent = generate_all_congruent(ships[i]);
        unordered_set<Triangle> unique_tris;
        for (const auto& tri : congruent) {
            vector<Triangle> translated = generate_translations(tri);
            for (const auto& t : translated) {
                unique_tris.insert(t);
            }
        }
        options[i] = vector<Triangle>(unique_tris.begin(), unique_tris.end());
        if (options[i].size() > 200) {
            options[i].resize(200);
        }
    }

    int min_points = INT_MAX;
    vector<int> indices(4, 0);
    for (auto& t0 : options[0]) {
        unordered_set<Point> points;
        points.insert(t0.a);
        points.insert(t0.b);
        points.insert(t0.c);
        if (points.size() >= min_points) continue;

        for (auto& t1 : options[1]) {
            unordered_set<Point> p1 = points;
            p1.insert(t1.a);
            p1.insert(t1.b);
            p1.insert(t1.c);
            if (p1.size() >= min_points) continue;

            for (auto& t2 : options[2]) {
                unordered_set<Point> p2 = p1;
                p2.insert(t2.a);
                p2.insert(t2.b);
                p2.insert(t2.c);
                if (p2.size() >= min_points) continue;

                for (auto& t3 : options[3]) {
                    unordered_set<Point> p3 = p2;
                    p3.insert(t3.a);
                    p3.insert(t3.b);
                    p3.insert(t3.c);
                    if (p3.size() < min_points) {
                        min_points = p3.size();
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

vector<long long> lucky;

void generate_lucky() {
    queue<long long> q;
    q.push(4);
    q.push(7);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        long long num = q.front();
        q.pop();
        lucky.push_back(num);
        if (num > 1e18) continue;
        long long next4 = num * 10 + 4;
        if (next4 <= 1e18) q.push(next4);
        long long next7 = num * 10 + 7;
        if (next7 <= 1e18) q.push(next7);
    }
    sort(lucky.begin(), lucky.end());
}

int count_digit(long long num, int d) {
    int cnt = 0;
    while (num > 0) {
        if (num % 10 == d) cnt++;
        num /= 10;
    }
    return cnt;
}

int f4(long long num) { return count_digit(num, 4); }
int f7(long long num) { return count_digit(num, 7); }

map<tuple<int, int, int, bool, bool, bool>, long long> memo;

long long dp(int pos, int count4, int count7, bool tight_low, bool tight_high, bool started, const string &L, const string &R) {
    if (pos == L.size()) return started ? count4 * count7 : 0;
    auto key = make_tuple(pos, count4, count7, tight_low, tight_high, started);
    if (memo.count(key)) return memo[key];

    long long max_prod = -1;
    int lower = tight_low ? L[pos] - '0' : 0;
    int upper = tight_high ? R[pos] - '0' : 9;

    for (int d = lower; d <= upper; d++) {
        bool new_tight_low = tight_low && (d == lower);
        bool new_tight_high = tight_high && (d == upper);
        bool new_started = started || (d != 0);
        int new_c4 = count4, new_c7 = count7;

        if (new_started) {
            if (d == 4) new_c4++;
            else if (d == 7) new_c7++;
        }

        long long res = dp(pos+1, new_c4, new_c7, new_tight_low, new_tight_high, new_started, L, R);
        max_prod = max(max_prod, res);
    }

    return memo[key] = max_prod;
}

long long compute_max_product(long long a, long long b) {
    string L = to_string(a), R = to_string(b);
    int n = max(L.size(), R.size());
    while (L.size() < n) L = "0" + L;
    while (R.size() < n) R = "0" + R;
    memo.clear();
    return dp(0, 0, 0, true, true, false, L, R);
}

int main() {
    generate_lucky();
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);

    int T;
    cin >> T;
    while (T--) {
        long long L, R;
        cin >> L >> R;
        long long max_prod = max(f4(L)*f7(L), f4(R)*f7(R));

        auto it_low = lower_bound(lucky.begin(), lucky.end(), L);
        auto it_high = upper_bound(lucky.begin(), lucky.end(), R);
        for (auto it = it_low; it != it_high; ++it) {
            int prod = f4(*it) * f7(*it);
            max_prod = max(max_prod, (long long)prod);
        }

        if (max_prod == 0) {
            long long dp_max = compute_max_product(L, R);
            max_prod = max(max_prod, dp_max);
        }

        cout << max_prod << '\n';
    }

    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Node {
    int min_val;
    int add;
    Node() : min_val(0), add(0) {}
};

vector<Node> tree;
int N;

void push(int node, int l, int r) {
    if (tree[node].add != 0 && l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r)/2;
        int left = 2*node;
        tree[left].min_val += tree[node].add;
        tree[left].add += tree[node].add;

        int right = 2*node +1;
        tree[right].min_val += tree[node].add;
        tree[right].add += tree[node].add;

        tree[node].add = 0;
    }
}

void build(int node, int l, int r, const vector<int>& a) {
    if (l == r) {
        tree[node].min_val = a[l];
        tree[node].add = 0;
    } else {
        int mid = (l + r)/2;
        build(2*node, l, mid, a);
        build(2*node+1, mid+1, r, a);
        tree[node].min_val = min(tree[2*node].min_val, tree[2*node+1].min_val);
        tree[node].add = 0;
    }
}

void update_range(int node, int l, int r, int ul, int ur, int val) {
    if (ur < l || ul > r) return;
    if (ul <= l && r <= ur) {
        tree[node].min_val += val;
        tree[node].add += val;
    } else {
        push(node, l, r);
        int mid = (l + r)/2;
        update_range(2*node, l, mid, ul, ur, val);
        update_range(2*node+1, mid+1, r, ul, ur, val);
        tree[node].min_val = min(tree[2*node].min_val, tree[2*node+1].min_val);
    }
}

int query_range(int node, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (qr < l || ql > r) return INT_MAX;
    if (ql <= l && r <= qr) {
        return tree[node].min_val;
    } else {
        push(node, l, r);
        int mid = (l + r)/2;
        int left_min = query_range(2*node, l, mid, ql, qr);
        int right_min = query_range(2*node+1, mid+1, r, ql, qr);
        return min(left_min, right_min);
    }
}

vector<int> computeFailure(const string& pat) {
    int m = pat.size();
    vector<int> fail(m, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i < m; ++i) {
        int j = fail[i-1];
        while (j > 0 && pat[i] != pat[j]) {
            j = fail[j-1];
        }
        if (pat[i] == pat[j]) {
            j++;
        }
        fail[i] = j;
    }
    return fail;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int solve(const vector<int>& a, int x, int y) {
    int n = a.size();
    int count_x = 0, count_y = 0;
    unordered_map<int, int> other;
    int max_other = 0;
    int max_len = 0;
    int left = 0;

    for (int right = 0; right < n; ++right) {
        int c = a[right];
        if (c == x) {
            count_x++;
        } else if (c == y) {
            count_y++;
        } else {
            other[c]++;
            if (other[c] > max_other) {
                max_other = other[c];
            }
        }

        while (left <= right) {
            bool valid = (count_x == count_y) && (max_other <= count_x);
            if (valid) break;

            int d = a[left];
            if (d == x) {
                count_x--;
            } else if (d == y) {
                count_y--;
            } else {
                other[d]--;
                if (other[d] == 0) {
                    other.erase(d);
                    if (max_other == other[d] + 1) {
                        max_other = 0;
                        for (const auto& p : other) {
                            if (p.second > max_other) {
                                max_other = p.second;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    if (other[d] + 1 == max_other) {
                        max_other--;
                    }
                }
            }
            left++;
        }

        if (count_x == count_y && count_x > 0) {
            max_len = max(max_len, right - left + 1);
        }
    }

    return max_len;
}

    }

    vector<pair<int, int>> elements;
    for (auto& p : freq) {
        elements.emplace_back(-p.second, p.first);
    }
    sort(elements.begin(), elements.end());

    vector<int> candidates;
    for (auto& p : elements) {
        candidates.push_back(p.second);
        if (candidates.size() >= 200) {
            break;
        }
    }

    int max_len = 0;
    for (int x : candidates) {
        for (int y : candidates) {
            if (x == y) continue;
            int current = solve(a, x, y);
            if (current > max_len) {
                max_len = current;
            }
        }
    }

    bool all_distinct = (freq.size() == n);
    if (all_distinct) {
        max_len = n;
    } else {
        for (int x : candidates) {
            int current = solve(a, x, x);
            if (current > max_len) {
                max_len = current;
            }
        }
        for (auto& p : freq) {
            if (p.second >= 2) {
                max_len = max(max_len, 2);
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    cout << max_len << '\n';

    return 0;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    vector<pair<int, string>> events;
    unordered_set<string> friends;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        int type;
        cin >> type;
        if (type == 1) {
            events.emplace_back(1, "");
        } else {
            string s;
            cin >> s;
            events.emplace_back(2, s);
            friends.insert(s);
        }
    }

    map<string, int> name_to_idx;
    int current_id = 0;
    for (const auto& s : friends) {
        name_to_idx[s] = current_id++;
    }

    vector<unordered_set<int>> intervals;
    int current_interval = -1;

    for (const auto& event : events) {
        if (event.first == 1) {
            ++current_interval;
            intervals.emplace_back();
        } else {
            if (current_interval >= 0) {
                int id = name_to_idx[event.second];
                intervals[current_interval].insert(id);
            }
        }
    }

    vector<vector<int>> friend_intervals(m);
    for (int i = 0; i < intervals.size(); ++i) {
        for (int s : intervals[i]) {
            friend_intervals[s].push_back(i);
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        sort(friend_intervals[i].begin(), friend_intervals[i].end());
    }

    vector<uint64_t> adj_complement_mask(m, 0);

    for (int u = 0; u < m; ++u) {
        for (int v = 0; v < m; ++v) {
            if (u == v) continue;
            bool are_disjoint = true;
            const auto& u_iv = friend_intervals[u];
            const auto& v_iv = friend_intervals[v];
            int i = 0, j = 0;
            while (i < u_iv.size() && j < v_iv.size()) {
                if (u_iv[i] == v_iv[j]) {
                    are_disjoint = false;
                    break;
                } else if (u_iv[i] < v_iv[j]) {
                    ++i;
                } else {
                    ++j;
                }
            }
            if (are_disjoint) {
                adj_complement_mask[u] |= (1ULL << v);
            }
        }
    }

    int max_clique = 0;
    function<void(uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t)> bronKerbosch = [&](uint64_t R, uint64_t P, uint64_t X) {
        if (P == 0 && X == 0) {
            max_clique = max(max_clique, (int)__builtin_popcountll(R));
            return;
        }
        uint64_t U = P | X;
        int pivot = U ? __builtin_ctzll(U) : -1;
        uint64_t candidates = (pivot == -1) ? P : (P & ~adj_complement_mask[pivot]);
        while (candidates) {
            int v = __builtin_ctzll(candidates);
            uint64_t mask = 1ULL << v;
            bronKerbosch(R | mask, P & adj_complement_mask[v], X & adj_complement_mask[v]);
            P &= ~mask;
            X |= mask;
            candidates &= ~mask;
        }
    };

    bronKerbosch(0, (1ULL << m) - 1, 0);
    cout << max_clique << '\n';

    return 0;

const int INF = 1e9;

struct Point {
    int x, y;
    Point(int x = 0, int y = 0) : x(x), y(y) {}

    bool operator<(const Point& other) const {
        if (x != other.x) return x < other.x;
        return y < other.y;
    }
};

int main() {
    int n, m, k;
    cin >> n >> m >> k;

    vector<vector<int>> a(n, vector<int>(m));
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
            cin >> a[i][j];
        }
    }

    vector<Point> points;
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        int x, y;
        cin >> x >> y;
        x--; y--;
        points.emplace_back(x, y);
    }

    sort(points.begin(), points.end());
    int best_sum = INF;
    vector<Point> best_cells;

    do {
        int current_sum = 0;
        vector<vector<bool>> current_tree(n, vector<bool>(m, false));
        Point first = points[0];
        current_tree[first.x][first.y] = true;
        current_sum = a[first.x][first.y];

        bool valid = true;
        for (int step = 1; step < k; ++step) {
            Point target = points[step];

            vector<vector<int>> dist(n, vector<int>(m, INF));
            vector<vector<Point>> parent(n, vector<Point>(m, Point(-1, -1)));
            priority_queue<tuple<int, int, int>, vector<tuple<int, int, int>>, greater<tuple<int, int, int>>> pq;

            for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
                for (int y = 0; y < m; ++y) {
                    if (current_tree[x][y]) {
                        dist[x][y] = 0;
                        pq.emplace(0, x, y);
                    }
                }
            }

            bool found = false;
            while (!pq.empty()) {
                auto [cost, x, y] = pq.top();
                pq.pop();

                if (x == target.x && y == target.y) {
                    found = true;
                    break;
                }

                if (cost > dist[x][y]) continue;

                const int dx[] = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
                const int dy[] = {0, 0, -1, 1};
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                    int nx = x + dx[d];
                    int ny = y + dy[d];
                    if (nx < 0 || nx >= n || ny < 0 || ny >= m) continue;

                    int new_cost = cost + (current_tree[nx][ny] ? 0 : a[nx][ny]);
                    if (new_cost < dist[nx][ny]) {
                        dist[nx][ny] = new_cost;
                        parent[nx][ny] = Point(x, y);
                        pq.emplace(new_cost, nx, ny);
                    }
                }
            }

            if (!found) {
                valid = false;
                break;
            }

            vector<Point> path;
            Point current(target.x, target.y);
            while (true) {
                path.push_back(current);
                if (current_tree[current.x][current.y]) break;
                Point p = parent[current.x][current.y];
                if (p.x == -1 && p.y == -1) break;
                current = p;
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < path.size() - 1; ++i) {
                auto& cell = path[i];
                if (!current_tree[cell.x][cell.y]) {
                    current_tree[cell.x][cell.y] = true;
                    current_sum += a[cell.x][cell.y];
                }
            }
        }

        if (valid && current_sum < best_sum) {
            best_sum = current_sum;
            best_cells.clear();
            for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
                for (int y = 0; y < m; ++y) {
                    if (current_tree[x][y]) {
                        best_cells.emplace_back(x, y);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

    } while (next_permutation(points.begin(), points.end()));

    cout << best_sum << endl;

    vector<vector<char>> grid(n, vector<char>(m, '.'));
    for (auto& p : best_cells) {
        grid[p.x][p.y] = 'X';
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
            cout << grid[i][j];
        }
        cout << endl;
    }

    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>

const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;

int main() {
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    vector<int> w(n);
    int a = 0, b = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> w[i];
        if (w[i] == 50) a++;
        else b++;
    }

    for (int x : w) {
        if (x > k) {
            cout << "-1\n0\n";
            return 0;
        }
    }

    vector<vector<long long>> comb(51, vector<long long>(51, 0));
    comb[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 50; ++i) {
        comb[i][0] = 1;
        comb[i][i] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j < i; ++j) {
            comb[i][j] = (comb[i-1][j-1] + comb[i-1][j]) % MOD;
        }
    }

    int initial_a = a, initial_b = b;
    int dist[51][51][2];
    long long cnt[51][51][2];
    memset(dist, -1, sizeof(dist));
    queue<tuple<int, int, int>> q;

    dist[a][b][0] = 0;
    cnt[a][b][0] = 1;
    q.emplace(a, b, 0);

    while (!q.empty()) {
        auto [curr_a, curr_b, pos] = q.front();
        q.pop();
        int curr_dist = dist[curr_a][curr_b][pos];
        long long curr_cnt = cnt[curr_a][curr_b][pos];

        if (pos == 0) {
            for (int x = 0; x <= curr_a; ++x) {
                for (int y = 0; y <= curr_b; ++y) {
                    if (x + y == 0 || 50*x + 100*y > k) continue;
                    int na = curr_a - x, nb = curr_b - y;
                    int np = 1;
                    long long ways = (comb[curr_a][x] * comb[curr_b][y]) % MOD;
                    if (dist[na][nb][np] == -1) {
                        dist[na][nb][np] = curr_dist + 1;
                        cnt[na][nb][np] = (curr_cnt * ways) % MOD;
                        q.emplace(na, nb, np);
                    } else if (dist[na][nb][np] == curr_dist + 1) {
                        cnt[na][nb][np] = (cnt[na][nb][np] + curr_cnt * ways) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            int other_a = initial_a - curr_a;
            int other_b = initial_b - curr_b;
            for (int x = 0; x <= other_a; ++x) {
                for (int y = 0; y <= other_b; ++y) {
                    if (x + y == 0 || 50*x + 100*y > k) continue;
                    int na = curr_a + x, nb = curr_b + y;
                    int np = 0;
                    long long ways = (comb[other_a][x] * comb[other_b][y]) % MOD;
                    if (dist[na][nb][np] == -1) {
                        dist[na][nb][np] = curr_dist + 1;
                        cnt[na][nb][np] = (curr_cnt * ways) % MOD;
                        q.emplace(na, nb, np);
                    } else if (dist[na][nb][np] == curr_dist + 1) {
                        cnt[na][nb][np] = (cnt[na][nb][np] + curr_cnt * ways) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (dist[0][0][1] == -1) {
        cout << "-1\n0\n";
    } else {
        cout << dist[0][0][1] << "\n" << cnt[0][0][1] % MOD << "\n";
    }

    return 0;

#include <vector>

typedef long long ll;

const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;

struct Matrix {
    vector<vector<ll>> mat;
    Matrix(int n) : mat(n, vector<ll>(n, 0)) {}
};

Matrix multiply(const Matrix& a, const Matrix& b) {
    int n = a.mat.size();
    Matrix res(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
                res.mat[i][j] = (res.mat[i][j] + a.mat[i][k] * b.mat[k][j]) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    return res;
}

Matrix power(Matrix a, ll p) {
    int n = a.mat.size();
    Matrix res(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) res.mat[i][i] = 1;
    while (p > 0) {
        if (p & 1) res = multiply(res, a);
        a = multiply(a, a);
        p >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

vector<ll> multiply(const Matrix& mat, const vector<ll>& vec) {
    int n = vec.size();
    vector<ll> res(n, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
            res[i] = (res[i] + mat.mat[i][k] * vec[k]) % MOD;
        }
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, x;
    cin >> n >> x;
    vector<int> d(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> d[i];
    }

    int m = *max_element(d.begin(), d.end());
    if (m == 0) {
        cout << 1 << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    vector<int> cnt(m + 1, 0);
    for (int di : d) {
        cnt[di]++;
    }

    vector<ll> dp(m, 0);
    dp[0] = 1;
    for (int s = 1; s < m; ++s) {
        for (int k = 1; k <= s; ++k) {
            dp[s] = (dp[s] + cnt[k] * dp[s - k]) % MOD;
        }
    }

    ll sum_initial = 0;
    for (int s = 0; s < m; ++s) {
        sum_initial = (sum_initial + dp[s]) % MOD;
    }

    if (x < m) {
        ll ans = 0;
        for (int s = 0; s <= x; ++s) {
            ans = (ans + dp[s]) % MOD;
        }
        cout << ans << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    int steps = x - m + 1;
    int size = m + 1;
    Matrix trans(size);

    for (int k = 1; k <= m; ++k) {
        trans.mat[0][k - 1] = cnt[k];
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < m; ++i) {
        trans.mat[i][i - 1] = 1;
    }
    trans.mat[m][0] = 1;
    trans.mat[m][m] = 1;

    Matrix trans_pow = power(trans, steps);

    vector<ll> vec(size, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        vec[i] = dp[m - 1 - i];
    }
    vec[m] = sum_initial;

    vector<ll> res = multiply(trans_pow, vec);
    cout << res[m] % MOD << endl;

    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>

const int MAX = 2e4 + 10;
vector<bool> is_prime(MAX, true);

void sieve() {
    is_prime[0] = is_prime[1] = false;
    for (int i = 2; i * i < MAX; ++i) {
        if (is_prime[i]) {
            for (int j = i * i; j < MAX; j += i) {
                is_prime[j] = false;
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    sieve();
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (auto &x : a) cin >> x;

    vector<int> evens, odds;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (a[i] % 2 == 0) {
            evens.push_back(i + 1);
        } else {
            odds.push_back(i + 1);
        }
    }

    if (evens.size() != odds.size()) {
        cout << "Impossible\n";
        return 0;
    }

    vector<unordered_set<int>> even_adj(n + 1), odd_adj(n + 1);
    for (int u : evens) {
        for (int v : odds) {
            if (is_prime[a[u - 1] + a[v - 1]]) {
                even_adj[u].insert(v);
                odd_adj[v].insert(u);
            }
        }
    }

    for (int u : evens) {
        if (even_adj[u].size() % 2 != 0) {
            cout << "Impossible\n";
            return 0;
        }
    }
    for (int v : odds) {
        if (odd_adj[v].size() % 2 != 0) {
            cout << "Impossible\n";
            return 0;
        }
    }

    auto current_even_adj = even_adj;
    auto current_odd_adj = odd_adj;

    vector<vector<int>> tables;

    for (int u : evens) {
        while (!current_even_adj[u].empty()) {
            vector<int> cycle;
            int current = u;
            bool is_even = true;
            cycle.push_back(current);
            while (true) {
                if (is_even) {
                    int next_node = *current_even_adj[current].begin();
                    current_even_adj[current].erase(next_node);
                    current_odd_adj[next_node].erase(current);
                    cycle.push_back(next_node);
                    current = next_node;
                    is_even = false;
                } else {
                    int next_node = *current_odd_adj[current].begin();
                    current_odd_adj[current].erase(next_node);
                    current_even_adj[next_node].erase(current);
                    cycle.push_back(next_node);
                    current = next_node;
                    is_even = true;
                }
                if (current == u && is_even) {
                    break;
                }
            }
            cycle.pop_back();
            tables.push_back(cycle);
        }
    }

    for (int u : evens) {
        if (!current_even_adj[u].empty()) {
            cout << "Impossible\n";
            return 0;
        }
    }
    for (int v : odds) {
        if (!current_odd_adj[v].empty()) {
            cout << "Impossible\n";
            return 0;
        }
    }

    cout << tables.size() << '\n';
    for (const auto &table : tables) {
        cout << table.size();
        for (int x : table) {
            cout << ' ' << x;
        }
        cout << '\n';
    }

    return 0;

string to_base(ll num, int d) {
    if (num == 0) return "0";
    string s;
    while (num > 0) {
        int rem = num % d;
        if (rem < 10) s += '0' + rem;
        else s += 'A' + (rem - 10);
        num /= d;
    }
    reverse(s.begin(), s.end());
    return s;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<ll> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        cin >> a[i];

    vector<vector<string>> base_str(n, vector<string>(15));
    vector<vector<int>> base_len(n, vector<int>(15));
    for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
        for (int d = 2; d <= 16; ++d) {
            base_str[j][d-2] = to_base(j, d);
            base_len[j][d-2] = base_str[j][d-2].size();
        }
    }

    int np = primes.size();
    vector<vector<bool>> div(n, vector<bool>(np, false));
    vector<vector<int>> mod_table(n, vector<int>(np));
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int p_idx = 0; p_idx < np; ++p_idx) {
            ll p = primes[p_idx];
            if (a[i] % p == 0) {
                div[i][p_idx] = true;
                mod_table[i][p_idx] = 0;
            } else {
                div[i][p_idx] = false;
                mod_table[i][p_idx] = a[i] % p;
            }
        }
    }

    int m;
    cin >> m;
    while (m--) {
        int d;
        string s;
        ll c;
        cin >> d >> s >> c;
        int L = s.size();
        vector<int> S;

        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            int d_idx = d - 2;
            const string& j_str = base_str[j][d_idx];
            int len_j = base_len[j][d_idx];
            if (len_j > L) continue;

            int a = L - len_j;
            bool valid = true;
            for (int k = 0; k < a; ++k) {
                if (s[k] != '0' && s[k] != '?') {
                    valid = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!valid) continue;

            for (int pos = 0; pos < len_j; ++pos) {
                char pc = s[a + pos];
                if (pc == '?') continue;
                char jc = j_str[pos];
                int p_digit, j_digit;
                if (isdigit(pc)) p_digit = pc - '0';
                else p_digit = 10 + toupper(pc) - 'A';
                if (isdigit(jc)) j_digit = jc - '0';
                else j_digit = 10 + toupper(jc) - 'A';
                if (p_digit != j_digit) {
                    valid = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (valid) S.push_back(j);
        }

        int ans = -1;
        for (int p_idx = 0; p_idx < np; ++p_idx) {
            ll p = primes[p_idx];
            bool has_div = false;
            for (int j : S) {
                if (div[j][p_idx]) {
                    has_div = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            ll product_mod_p;
            if (has_div) product_mod_p = 0;
            else {
                product_mod_p = 1;
                for (int j : S) {
                    product_mod_p = (product_mod_p * mod_table[j][p_idx]) % p;
                }
            }
            ll cm = c % p;
            ll z_mod = (product_mod_p + cm) % p;
            if (z_mod == 0 && (ans == -1 || primes[p_idx] < ans))
                ans = primes[p_idx];
        }
        cout << ans << '\n';
    }
    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;
const int MAXN = 1e5 + 5;

vector<int> adj[MAXN];
vector<vector<int>> components;
int disc[MAXN], low[MAXN], timeStamp;
stack<int> stk;
bool isArticulation[MAXN];
vector<int> blockId[MAXN];
vector<pair<int, int>> blockEdges;
vector<int> tree[MAXN];
vector<bool> isCycle;
vector<int> blockToNode;
int parent[MAXN];
int depth[MAXN];
int up[MAXN][20];
vector<int> blockEntries;

void bcc(int u, int p = -1) {
    disc[u] = low[u] = ++timeStamp;
    stk.push(u);
    int children = 0;
    for (int v : adj[u]) {
        if (v == p) continue;
        if (!disc[v]) {
            children++;
            bcc(v, u);
            low[u] = min(low[u], low[v]);
            if ((p == -1 && children > 1) || (p != -1 && low[v] >= disc[u])) {
                isArticulation[u] = true;
                components.push_back({});
                while (true) {
                    int w = stk.top(); stk.pop();
                    components.back().push_back(w);
                    if (w == v) break;
                }
                components.back().push_back(u);
            }
        } else {
            low[u] = min(low[u], disc[v]);
        }
    }
    if (p == -1 && children == 0) {
        components.push_back({u});
    }
}

void buildBCC() {
    timeStamp = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
        disc[i] = low[i] = 0;
        isArticulation[i] = false;
    }
    components.clear();
    for (int u = 1; u < MAXN; u++) {
        if (!disc[u] && !adj[u].empty()) {
            bcc(u);
            if (!stk.empty()) {
                components.push_back({});
                while (!stk.empty()) {
                    components.back().push_back(stk.top());
                    stk.pop();
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for (auto& comp : components) {
        set<int> s(comp.begin(), comp.end());
        if (comp.size() == 2) {
            isCycle.push_back(false);
        } else {
            bool cycle = true;
            for (int u : comp) {
                int cnt = 0;
                for (int v : adj[u]) {
                    if (s.count(v)) cnt++;
                }
                if (cnt != 2) {
                    cycle = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            isCycle.push_back(cycle);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < components.size(); i++) {
        for (int u : components[i]) {
            blockId[u].push_back(i);
        }
    }
    blockEntries.resize(components.size());
    for (int i = 0; i < components.size(); i++) {
        set<int> arts;
        for (int u : components[i]) {
            if (isArticulation[u]) {
                arts.insert(u);
            }
        }
        blockEntries[i] = arts.size();
    }
}

void buildBlockTree() {
    int numBlocks = components.size();
    blockToNode.assign(numBlocks, -1);
    vector<set<int>> blockAdj(numBlocks);
    for (int u = 1; u < MAXN; u++) {
        if (blockId[u].size() > 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < blockId[u].size(); i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j < blockId[u].size(); j++) {
                    int a = blockId[u][i];
                    int b = blockId[u][j];
                    blockAdj[a].insert(b);
                    blockAdj[b].insert(a);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < numBlocks; i++) {
        tree[i].clear();
        for (int j : blockAdj[i]) {
            tree[i].push_back(j);
        }
    }
}

void dfs(int u, int p, int d) {
    parent[u] = p;
    depth[u] = d;
    up[u][0] = p;
    for (int i = 1; i < 20; i++) {
        up[u][i] = up[up[u][i-1]][i-1];
    }
    for (int v : tree[u]) {
        if (v != p) {
            dfs(v, u, d + 1);
        }
    }
}

int lca(int u, int v) {
    if (depth[u] < depth[v]) swap(u, v);
    for (int i = 19; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (depth[u] - (1 << i) >= depth[v]) {
            u = up[u][i];
        }
    }
    if (u == v) return u;
    for (int i = 19; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (up[u][i] != up[v][i]) {
            u = up[u][i];
            v = up[v][i];
        }
    }
    return up[u][0];
}

vector<int> getPath(int u, int v) {
    int ancestor = lca(u, v);
    vector<int> pathU, pathV;
    while (u != ancestor) {
        pathU.push_back(u);
        u = parent[u];
    }
    while (v != ancestor) {
        pathV.push_back(v);
        v = parent[v];
    }
    pathU.push_back(ancestor);
    reverse(pathV.begin(), pathV.end());
    pathU.insert(pathU.end(), pathV.begin(), pathV.end());
    return pathU;
}

        }

        int u = blocksX[0], v = blocksY[0];

        int cnt = 0;
        for (int b : path) {

        long long ans = 1;

            ans = (ans * 2) % MOD;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

int n;
ll y, m;
vector<vector<int>> adj;
vector<int> result;
vector<vector<int>> dag;

ll k;
vector<int> used_mask_stack;

struct State {
    int mask;
    int pos;
    vector<int> constraints_low;
    vector<int> constraints_high;

    bool operator<(const State& other) const {
        if (mask != other.mask) return mask < other.mask;
        if (pos != other.pos) return pos < other.pos;
        if (constraints_low != other.constraints_low) return constraints_low < other.constraints_low;
        return constraints_high < other.constraints_high;
    }
};

map<State, ll> memo;

ll count_linear_extensions(int mask, int pos, const vector<int>& constraints_low, const vector<int>& constraints_high) {
    if (mask == (1 << n) - 1) return 1;

    State state = {mask, pos, constraints_low, constraints_high};
    if (memo.find(state) != memo.end()) {
        return memo[state];
    }

    ll total = 0;
    for (int next_seat = pos; next_seat < n; ++next_seat) {
        if (mask & (1 << next_seat)) continue;

        bool can_assign = true;
        for (int v : dag[next_seat]) {
            if (!(mask & (1 << v))) {
                can_assign = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!can_assign) continue;

        int required_low = constraints_low[next_seat];
        int required_high = constraints_high[next_seat];

        for (int num = required_low; num <= required_high; ++num) {
            if ((used_mask_stack[next_seat] & (1 << (num - 1))) == 0) {
                bool valid = true;
                for (int prev_seat = 0; prev_seat < n; ++prev_seat) {
                    if ((mask & (1 << prev_seat)) && (adj[prev_seat][next_seat] || adj[next_seat][prev_seat])) {
                        int prev_num = (used_mask_stack[prev_seat] & -used_mask_stack[prev_seat]);
                        prev_num = __builtin_ctz(prev_num) + 1;
                        if (adj[prev_seat][next_seat] && prev_num >= num) valid = false;
                        if (adj[next_seat][prev_seat] && prev_num <= num) valid = false;
                        if (!valid) break;
                    }
                }
                if (valid) {
                    vector<int> new_constraints_low = constraints_low;
                    vector<int> new_constraints_high = constraints_high;
                    for (int seat = 0; seat < n; ++seat) {
                        if (seat == next_seat || (mask & (1 << seat))) continue;
                        if (adj[next_seat][seat]) {
                            new_constraints_low[seat] = max(new_constraints_low[seat], num + 1);
                        }
                        if (adj[seat][next_seat]) {
                            new_constraints_high[seat] = min(new_constraints_high[seat], num - 1);
                        }
                    }
                    vector<int> new_used = used_mask_stack;
                    new_used[next_seat] |= 1 << (num - 1);
                    used_mask_stack.swap(new_used);
                    ll cnt = count_linear_extensions(mask | (1 << next_seat), pos, new_constraints_low, new_constraints_high);
                    used_mask_stack.swap(new_used);
                    total += cnt;
                }
            }
        }
        break;
    }

    memo[state] = total;
    return total;
}

bool has_cycle() {
    vector<int> in_degree(n, 0);
    for (int u = 0; u < n; ++u) {
        for (int v : dag[u]) {
            in_degree[v]++;
        }
    }
    queue<int> q;
    for (int u = 0; u < n; ++u) {
        if (in_degree[u] == 0) q.push(u);
    }
    int visited = 0;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front();
        q.pop();
        visited++;
        for (int v : dag[u]) {
            if (--in_degree[v] == 0) q.push(v);
        }
    }
    return visited != n;
}

void find_kth_permutation(int pos, vector<int>& current, vector<bool>& used, const vector<int>& constraints_low, const vector<int>& constraints_high, int mask) {
    if (pos == n) {
        result = current;
        return;
    }

    for (int num = 1; num <= n; ++num) {
        if (used[num]) continue;

        bool valid = true;
        for (int prev_seat = 0; prev_seat < pos; ++prev_seat) {
            int a = prev_seat;
            int b = pos;
            if (adj[a][b] && current[prev_seat] >= num) valid = false;
            if (adj[b][a] && current[prev_seat] <= num) valid = false;
            if (!valid) break;
        }
        if (!valid) continue;

        vector<int> new_constraints_low = constraints_low;
        vector<int> new_constraints_high = constraints_high;
        for (int seat = pos; seat < n; ++seat) {
            if (seat == pos) continue;
            if (adj[pos][seat]) new_constraints_low[seat] = max(new_constraints_low[seat], num + 1);
            if (adj[seat][pos]) new_constraints_high[seat] = min(new_constraints_high[seat], num - 1);
            if (new_constraints_low[seat] > new_constraints_high[seat]) {
                valid = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!valid) continue;

        used[num] = true;
        current[pos] = num;

        used_mask_stack = vector<int>(n, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < pos; ++i) {
            used_mask_stack[i] = 1 << (current[i] - 1);
        }
        used_mask_stack[pos] = 1 << (num - 1);

        memo.clear();
        ll cnt = count_linear_extensions((1 << (pos + 1)) - 1, pos + 1, new_constraints_low, new_constraints_high);

        if (k <= cnt) {
            find_kth_permutation(pos + 1, current, used, new_constraints_low, new_constraints_high, mask | (1 << pos));
            return;
        } else {
            k -= cnt;
        }

        used[num] = false;
        current[pos] = 0;
    }
}

int main() {
    cin >> n >> y >> m;
    k = y - 2000;

    adj.assign(n, vector<int>(n, 0));
    dag.resize(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int a, b;
        cin >> a >> b;
        a--; b--;
        adj[a][b] = 1;
        dag[a].push_back(b);
    }

    if (has_cycle()) {
        cout << "The times have changed" << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    vector<int> current(n, 0);
    vector<bool> used(n + 1, false);
    vector<int> constraints_low(n, 1);
    vector<int> constraints_high(n, n);

    find_kth_permutation(0, current, used, constraints_low, constraints_high, 0);

    if (result.empty()) {
        cout << "The times have changed" << endl;
    } else {
        for (int x : result) {
            cout << x << " ";
        }
        cout << endl;
    }

    return 0;

#include <iostream>

#include <climits>

using namespace std;

vector<int> get_lucky_numbers(int n) {
    vector<int> lucky;
    queue<string> q;
    q.push("4");
    q.push("7");
    while (!q.empty()) {
        string s = q.front();
        q.pop();
        int num = stoi(s);
        if (num > n) continue;
        lucky.push_back(num);
        q.push(s + "4");
        q.push(s + "7");
    }
    return lucky;
}

vector<int> get_components(int n, const vector<pair<int, int>>& edges) {
    vector<vector<int>> adj(n + 1);
    for (auto [u, v] : edges) {
        adj[u].push_back(v);
        adj[v].push_back(u);
    }
    vector<bool> visited(n + 1, false);
    vector<int> sizes;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        if (!visited[i]) {
            queue<int> q;
            q.push(i);
            visited[i] = true;
            int size = 0;
            while (!q.empty()) {
                int u = q.front();
                q.pop();
                size++;
                for (int v : adj[u]) {
                    if (!visited[v]) {
                        visited[v] = true;
                        q.push(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            sizes.push_back(size);
        }
    }
    return sizes;
}

bool is_lucky(int x) {
    string s = to_string(x);
    for (char c : s) {
        if (c != '4' && c != '7') return false;
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    vector<pair<int, int>> edges;
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        edges.emplace_back(u, v);
    }

    vector<int> sizes = get_components(n, edges);

    for (int s : sizes) {
        if (is_lucky(s)) {
            cout << "0\n";
            return 0;
        }
    }

    vector<int> lucky = get_lucky_numbers(n);
    if (lucky.empty()) {
        cout << "-1\n";
        return 0;
    }

    vector<int> dp(n + 1, INT_MAX);
    dp[0] = 0;
    for (int x : sizes) {
        for (int s = n; s >= x; --s) {
            if (dp[s - x] != INT_MAX) {
                dp[s] = min(dp[s], dp[s - x] + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    int min_roads = INT_MAX;
    for (int s : lucky) {
        if (dp[s] != INT_MAX) {
            min_roads = min(min_roads, dp[s] - 1);
        }
    }

    if (min_roads == INT_MAX) {
        cout << "-1\n";
    } else {
        cout << min_roads << "\n";
    }

    return 0;

#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <cstring>
