using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;

struct AhoCorasick {
    struct Node {
        vector<int> children;
        int fail;
        int total_value;
        int value;
        Node(int m) : children(m, -1), fail(0), total_value(0), value(0) {}
    };

    vector<Node> nodes;
    int m;

    AhoCorasick(int m) : m(m) {
        nodes.emplace_back(m);
    }

    void add_pattern(const vector<int>& digits, int val) {
        int current = 0;
        for (int d : digits) {
            if (nodes[current].children[d] == -1) {
                nodes[current].children[d] = nodes.size();
                nodes.emplace_back(m);
            }
            current = nodes[current].children[d];
        }
        nodes[current].value += val;
    }

    void build_failure() {
        queue<int> q;
        for (int d = 0; d < m; ++d) {
            if (nodes[0].children[d] != -1) {
                int child = nodes[0].children[d];
                nodes[child].fail = 0;
                q.push(child);
            } else {
                nodes[0].children[d] = 0;
            }
        }
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front();
            q.pop();
            for (int d = 0; d < m; ++d) {
                int v = nodes[u].children[d];
                if (v != -1) {
                    int f = nodes[u].fail;
                    while (f != 0 && nodes[f].children[d] == -1) {
                        f = nodes[f].fail;
                    }
                    if (nodes[f].children[d] != -1) {
                        f = nodes[f].children[d];
                    }
                    nodes[v].fail = f;
                    nodes[v].total_value = nodes[v].value + nodes[f].total_value;
                    q.push(v);
                }
            }
        }
    }
};

vector<int> read_number() {
    int len;
    scanf("%d", &len);
    vector<int> digits(len);
    for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
        scanf("%d", &digits[i]);
    }
    return digits;
}

vector<int> subtract_one(const vector<int>& digits, int m) {
    vector<int> res = digits;
    int carry = 1;
    for (int i = res.size() - 1; i >= 0 && carry; --i) {
        if (res[i] >= carry) {
            res[i] -= carry;
            carry = 0;
        } else {
            res[i] = m - carry + res[i];
            carry = 1;
        }
    }
    if (carry) return {};
    int first_non_zero = 0;
    while (first_non_zero < res.size() && res[first_non_zero] == 0) {
        ++first_non_zero;
    }
    if (first_non_zero == res.size()) {
        return {0};
    }
    return vector<int>(res.begin() + first_non_zero, res.end());
}

struct State {
    int pos;
    bool tight;
    int node;
    int sum;
    bool started;
    State(int p, bool t, int n, int s, bool st) : pos(p), tight(t), node(n), sum(s), started(st) {}
    bool operator==(const State& other) const {
        return pos == other.pos && tight == other.tight && node == other.node && sum == other.sum && started == other.started;
    }
};

namespace std {
    template <>
    struct hash<State> {
        size_t operator()(const State& s) const {
            size_t h = s.pos;
            h = h * 2 + s.tight;
            h = h * 200 + s.node;
            h = h * 501 + s.sum;
            h = h * 2 + s.started;
            return h;
        }
    };
}

unordered_map<State, int> memo;
vector<int> current_digits;
AhoCorasick* ac;
int K, M;

int dfs(int pos, bool tight, int node, int sum, bool started) {
    if (sum > K) return 0;
    if (pos == current_digits.size()) {
        if (!started) {
            return (current_digits.size() == 1 && current_digits[0] == 0 && sum <= K) ? 1 : 0;
        } else {
            return sum <= K ? 1 : 0;
        }
    }
    State s(pos, tight, node, sum, started);
    if (memo.count(s)) return memo[s];
    int limit = tight ? current_digits[pos] : (M - 1);
    int res = 0;
    for (int d = 0; d <= limit; ++d) {
        bool new_tight = tight && (d == limit);
        bool new_started = started || (d != 0);
        int new_node = node;
        int new_sum = sum;

        if (started) {
            int curr = node;
            while (curr != 0 && ac->nodes[curr].children[d] == -1) {
                curr = ac->nodes[curr].fail;
            }
            if (ac->nodes[curr].children[d] != -1) {
                new_node = ac->nodes[curr].children[d];
            } else {
                new_node = curr;
            }
            new_sum += ac->nodes[new_node].total_value;
        } else if (d != 0) {
            int curr = 0;
            while (curr != 0 && ac->nodes[curr].children[d] == -1) {
                curr = ac->nodes[curr].fail;
            }
            if (ac->nodes[curr].children[d] != -1) {
                new_node = ac->nodes[curr].children[d];
            } else {
                new_node = curr;
            }
            new_sum += ac->nodes[new_node].total_value;
            new_started = true;
        } else {
            new_node = 0;
        }

        if (new_sum > K) continue;

        res = (res + dfs(pos + 1, new_tight, new_node, new_sum, new_started)) % MOD;
    }
    memo[s] = res;
    return res;
}

int compute(const vector<int>& digits) {
    current_digits = digits;
    memo.clear();
    return dfs(0, true, 0, 0, false);
}

int main() {
    int n, m, k;
    scanf("%d %d %d", &n, &m, &k);
    M = m;
    K = k;
    vector<int> l = read_number();
    vector<int> r = read_number();
    AhoCorasick ac_local(m);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        vector<int> digits = read_number();
        int val;
        scanf("%d", &val);
        ac_local.add_pattern(digits, val);
    }
    ac_local.build_failure();
    ac = &ac_local;

    vector<int> l_minus_1 = subtract_one(l, m);
    if (l_minus_1.empty()) l_minus_1 = {0};

    int ans = (compute(r) - compute(l_minus_1) + MOD) % MOD;
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;

const long long INF = 1e18;

struct Edge {
    int to, rev, cap;
    long long cost;
};

vector<vector<Edge>> graph;

void add_edge(int from, int to, int cap, long long cost) {
    graph[from].push_back(Edge{to, (int)graph[to].size(), cap, cost});
    graph[to].push_back(Edge{from, (int)graph[from].size() -1, 0, -cost});
}

int main() {
    int n, q;
    cin >> n >> q;

    vector<int> lower(n+1, 1);
    vector<int> upper(n+1, n);

    for (int i = 0; i < q; ++i) {
        int t, l, r, v;
        cin >> t >> l >> r >> v;
        for (int x = l; x <= r; ++x) {
            if (t == 1) {
                lower[x] = max(lower[x], v);
            } else {
                upper[x] = min(upper[x], v);
            }
        }
    }

    bool possible = true;
    for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x) {
        if (lower[x] > upper[x]) {
            possible = false;
            break;
        }
    }

    if (!possible) {
        cout << -1 << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    int total_nodes = 2 * n + 2;
    int sink = 2 * n + 1;
    graph.resize(total_nodes);

    for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x) {
        add_edge(0, x, 1, 0);
    }

    for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x) {
        int l = lower[x], r = upper[x];
        for (int v = l; v <= r; ++v) {
            add_edge(x, n + v, 1, 0);
        }
    }

    for (int v = 1; v <= n; ++v) {
        for (int k = 1; k <= n; ++k) {
            long long cost = 2LL * k - 1;
            add_edge(n + v, sink, 1, cost);
        }
    }

    long long total_cost = 0;
    int total_flow = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        vector<long long> dist(total_nodes, INF);
        vector<int> prev_node(total_nodes, -1);
        vector<int> prev_edge(total_nodes, -1);
        dist[0] = 0;

        bool updated;
        for (int iter = 0; iter < total_nodes; ++iter) {
            updated = false;
            for (int u = 0; u < total_nodes; ++u) {
                if (dist[u] == INF) continue;
                for (int j = 0; j < graph[u].size(); ++j) {
                    Edge &e = graph[u][j];
                    if (e.cap > 0 && dist[e.to] > dist[u] + e.cost) {
                        dist[e.to] = dist[u] + e.cost;
                        prev_node[e.to] = u;
                        prev_edge[e.to] = j;
                        updated = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!updated) break;
        }

        if (dist[sink] == INF) {
            cout << -1 << endl;
            return 0;
        }

        int v = sink;
        while (v != 0) {
            int u = prev_node[v];
            int e_idx = prev_edge[v];
            Edge &e = graph[u][e_idx];
            e.cap -= 1;
            graph[v][e.rev].cap += 1;
            total_cost += e.cost;
            v = u;
        }

        total_flow += 1;
    }

    cout << total_cost << endl;

    return 0;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    vector<Edge> edges(m);
    map<pair<int, int>, int> edge_z;
    vector<vector<int>> adj(n+1);

    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int x, y, z;
        cin >> x >> y >> z;
        edges[i] = {x, y, z};
        adj[x].push_back(y);
        adj[y].push_back(x);
        if (x > y) swap(x, y);
        edge_z[{x, y}] = z;
    }

    auto bfs = [&](int start, vector<int>& dist) {
        dist.assign(n+1, -1);
        queue<int> q;
        dist[start] = 0;
        q.push(start);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front();
            q.pop();
            for (int v : adj[u]) {
                if (dist[v] == -1) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    q.push(v);
                }
            }
        }
    };

    vector<int> distance1, distanceN;
    bfs(1, distance1);
    bfs(n, distanceN);
    int total_length = distance1[n];

    vector<bool> in_s(m, false);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int x = edges[i].x, y = edges[i].y;
        bool cond1 = (distance1[x] + 1 + distanceN[y] == total_length);
        bool cond2 = (distance1[y] + 1 + distanceN[x] == total_length);
        in_s[i] = cond1 || cond2;
    }

    int fixed_cost = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i)
        if (!in_s[i] && edges[i].z == 1)
            fixed_cost++;

    vector<vector<pair<int, int>>> adj_sum_z(n+1);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        if (!in_s[i]) continue;
        int x = edges[i].x, y = edges[i].y, z = edges[i].z;
        if (distance1[x] + 1 == distance1[y])
            adj_sum_z[x].emplace_back(y, z);
        if (distance1[y] + 1 == distance1[x])
            adj_sum_z[y].emplace_back(x, z);
    }

    vector<int> sum_z(n+1, -1);
    sum_z[1] = 0;
    vector<int> predecessor(n+1, -1);

    vector<int> order(n);
    iota(order.begin(), order.end(), 1);
    sort(order.begin(), order.end(), [&](int a, int b) { return distance1[a] < distance1[b]; });

    for (int u : order) {
        if (sum_z[u] == -1) continue;
        for (auto [v, z] : adj_sum_z[u]) {
            if (sum_z[v] < sum_z[u] + z) {
                sum_z[v] = sum_z[u] + z;
                predecessor[v] = u;
            }
        }
    }

    vector<int> path;
    int current = n;
    while (current != 1) {
        path.push_back(current);
        current = predecessor[current];
    }
    path.push_back(1);
    reverse(path.begin(), path.end());

    vector<tuple<int, int, int>> affected;

    for (int i = 0; i < (int)path.size()-1; ++i) {
        int u = path[i], v = path[i+1];
        int a = min(u, v), b = max(u, v);
        if (edge_z[{a, b}] == 0)
            affected.emplace_back(a, b, 1);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        if (!in_s[i] && edges[i].z == 1) {
            int x = edges[i].x, y = edges[i].y;
            affected.emplace_back(min(x, y), max(x, y), 0);
        }
    }

    cout << affected.size() << '\n';
    for (auto [x, y, z] : affected)
        cout << x << ' ' << y << ' ' << z << '\n';

    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Node {
    long long sum;
    int i_orig;
    int a_pre;
    int b_pre;
    int j_max_pre;

    Node(long long s, int i, int a, int b, int j)
        : sum(s), i_orig(i), a_pre(a), b_pre(b), j_max_pre(j) {}
};

struct CompareNode {
    bool operator()(const Node& a, const Node& b) {
        return a.sum < b.sum;
    }
};

vector<int> log2_table;
vector<vector<int>> st;

void build_sparse_table(const vector<long long>& arr) {
    int n = arr.size();
    log2_table.resize(n + 1);
    log2_table[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        log2_table[i] = log2_table[i / 2] + 1;
    }
    int k_max = log2_table[n] + 1;
    st.resize(k_max, vector<int>(n));
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        st[0][i] = i;
    }
    for (int j = 1; j < k_max; ++j) {
        for (int i = 0; i + (1 << j) <= n; ++i) {
            int mid = i + (1 << (j-1));
            int left = st[j-1][i];
            int right = st[j-1][mid];
            if (arr[left] > arr[right]) {
                st[j][i] = left;
            } else {
                st[j][i] = right;
            }
        }
    }
}

int query_max_index(int l, int r, const vector<long long>& arr) {
    int len = r - l + 1;
    int j = log2_table[len];
    int k1 = st[j][l];
    int k2 = st[j][r - (1 << j) + 1];
    if (arr[k1] > arr[k2]) {
        return k1;
    } else {
        return k2;
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;

    vector<long long> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }

    vector<long long> prefix(n + 1);
    prefix[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        prefix[i] = prefix[i - 1] + a[i - 1];
    }

    build_sparse_table(prefix);

    priority_queue<Node, vector<Node>, CompareNode> pq;

    for (int i_orig = 0; i_orig < n; ++i_orig) {
        int a_pre = i_orig + 1;
        int b_pre = n;
        if (a_pre > b_pre) continue;
        int j_max_pre = query_max_index(a_pre, b_pre, prefix);
        long long sum = prefix[j_max_pre] - prefix[i_orig];
        pq.emplace(sum, i_orig, a_pre, b_pre, j_max_pre);
    }

    long long result = 0;

    for (int step = 0; step < k; ++step) {
        if (pq.empty()) break;
        Node current = pq.top();
        pq.pop();

        if (step == k - 1) {
            result = current.sum;
        }

        int new_a = current.a_pre;
        int new_b = current.j_max_pre - 1;
        if (new_a <= new_b) {
            int j_max_new = query_max_index(new_a, new_b, prefix);
            long long sum_new = prefix[j_max_new] - prefix[current.i_orig];
            pq.emplace(sum_new, current.i_orig, new_a, new_b, j_max_new);
        }

        new_a = current.j_max_pre + 1;
        new_b = current.b_pre;
        if (new_a <= new_b) {
            int j_max_new = query_max_index(new_a, new_b, prefix);
            long long sum_new = prefix[j_max_new] - prefix[current.i_orig];
            pq.emplace(sum_new, current.i_orig, new_a, new_b, j_max_new);
        }
    }

    cout << result << endl;

    return 0;

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <random>

using namespace std;

struct Point {
    double x, y;
    Point() : x(0), y(0) {}
    Point(double x_, double y_) : x(x_), y(y_) {}
};

struct Circle {
    Point center;
    double radius;
    Circle() : radius(0) {}
    Circle(Point c, double r) : center(c), radius(r) {}
};

double distance_sq(const Point& a, const Point& b) {
    double dx = a.x - b.x;
    double dy = a.y - b.y;
    return dx*dx + dy*dy;
}

Circle circle_from_two(const Point& a, const Point& b) {
    Point center((a.x + b.x)/2.0, (a.y + b.y)/2.0);
    double radius = sqrt(distance_sq(a, b)) / 2.0;
    return Circle(center, radius);
}

Circle circle_from_three(const Point& a, const Point& b, const Point& c) {
    double ox = (min(min(a.x, b.x), c.x) + max(min(a.x, b.x), c.x)) / 2.0;
    double oy = (min(min(a.y, b.y), c.y) + max(min(a.y, b.y), c.y)) / 2.0;
    double ax = a.x - ox, ay = a.y - oy;
    double bx = b.x - ox, by = b.y - oy;
    double cx = c.x - ox, cy = c.y - oy;
    double d = 2 * (ax * (by - cy) + bx * (cy - ay) + cx * (ay - by));
    if (d == 0) return Circle(Point(0,0), -1); // Indicate collinear case
    double x = ((ax*ax + ay*ay) * (by - cy) + (bx*bx + by*by) * (cy - ay) + (cx*cx + cy*cy) * (ay - by)) / d;
    double y = ((ax*ax + ay*ay) * (cx - bx) + (bx*bx + by*by) * (ax - cx) + (cx*cx + cy*cy) * (bx - ax)) / d;
    Point center(ox + x, oy + y);
    double radius = sqrt(distance_sq(center, a));
    return Circle(center, radius);
}

Circle welzl_helper(vector<Point>& points, int n, vector<Point> r) {
    if (n == 0 || r.size() == 3) {
        if (r.empty()) {
            return Circle(Point(0,0), 0);
        } else if (r.size() == 1) {
            return Circle(r[0], 0);
        } else if (r.size() == 2) {
            return circle_from_two(r[0], r[1]);
        } else {
            Circle c = circle_from_three(r[0], r[1], r[2]);
            if (c.radius >= 0) return c;
            double max_dist = 0;
            int a = 0, b = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
                for (int j = i+1; j < 3; ++j) {
                    double d = distance_sq(r[i], r[j]);
                    if (d > max_dist) {
                        max_dist = d;
                        a = i;
                        b = j;
                    }
                }
            }
            return circle_from_two(r[a], r[b]);
        }
    }

    int idx = rand() % n;
    Point p = points[idx];
    swap(points[idx], points[n-1]);

    Circle d = welzl_helper(points, n-1, r);

    if (distance_sq(d.center, p) <= d.radius * d.radius + 1e-8) {
        return d;
    }

    r.push_back(p);
    return welzl_helper(points, n-1, r);
}

Circle minimal_enclosing_circle(vector<Point> points) {
    if (points.empty()) return Circle();
    shuffle(points.begin(), points.end(), mt19937(random_device()()));
    return welzl_helper(points, points.size(), {});
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

vector<int> get_bits(int x) {
    vector<int> res(30, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < 30; ++i) {
        res[i] = (x >> (29 - i)) & 1;
    }
    return res;
}

ll solve(int l, int r) {
    auto L = get_bits(l);
    auto R = get_bits(r);
    
    ll dp[2][2][2][2][2] = {}; // a_low, a_high, b_low, b_high, conflict
    dp[0][0][0][0][0] = 1;
    
    for (int bit = 0; bit < 30; ++bit) {
        ll next_dp[2][2][2][2][2] = {};
        
        for (int a_low = 0; a_low < 2; ++a_low) {
            for (int a_high = 0; a_high < 2; ++a_high) {
                for (int b_low = 0; b_low < 2; ++b_low) {
                    for (int b_high = 0; b_high < 2; ++b_high) {
                        for (int conflict = 0; conflict < 2; ++conflict) {
                            ll cnt = dp[a_low][a_high][b_low][b_high][conflict];
                            if (cnt == 0) continue;
                            
                            for (int a_bit = 0; a_bit < 2; ++a_bit) {
                                // Check if a_bit is valid for current a_low and a_high
                                if (!a_low && a_bit < L[bit]) continue;
                                if (!a_high && a_bit > R[bit]) continue;
                                
                                for (int b_bit = 0; b_bit < 2; ++b_bit) {
                                    // Check if b_bit is valid for current b_low and b_high
                                    if (!b_low && b_bit < L[bit]) continue;
                                    if (!b_high && b_bit > R[bit]) continue;
                                    
                                    int new_conflict = conflict | (a_bit & b_bit);
                                    int new_a_low = a_low | (a_bit > L[bit]);
                                    int new_a_high = a_high | (a_bit < R[bit]);
                                    int new_b_low = b_low | (b_bit > L[bit]);
                                    int new_b_high = b_high | (b_bit < R[bit]);
                                    
                                    next_dp[new_a_low][new_a_high][new_b_low][new_b_high][new_conflict] += cnt;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        memcpy(dp, next_dp, sizeof(next_dp));
    }
    
    ll ans = 0;
    for (int a_low = 0; a_low < 2; ++a_low) {
        for (int a_high = 0; a_high < 2; ++a_high) {
            for (int b_low = 0; b_low < 2; ++b_low) {
                for (int b_high = 0; b_high < 2; ++b_high) {
                    ans += dp[a_low][a_high][b_low][b_high][0];
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

    int t;
    cin >> t;
    while (t--) {
        int l, r;
        cin >> l >> r;
        cout << solve(l, r) << '\n';
    }
    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MAXN = 4e5 + 10;

int tin[MAXN], tout[MAXN], timer;
vector<int> adj[MAXN];
int c[MAXN], color_array[MAXN];

struct Node {
    uint64_t mask;
    int lazy;
};

Node tree[4 * MAXN];

void dfs(int u, int p) {
    tin[u] = ++timer;
    for (int v : adj[u]) {
        if (v != p) {
            dfs(v, u);
        }
    }
    tout[u] = timer;
}

void build(int v, int tl, int tr) {
    if (tl == tr) {
        tree[v].mask = 1ULL << (color_array[tl] - 1);
        tree[v].lazy = 0;
    } else {
        int tm = (tl + tr) / 2;
        build(2*v, tl, tm);
        build(2*v+1, tm+1, tr);
        tree[v].mask = tree[2*v].mask | tree[2*v+1].mask;
        tree[v].lazy = 0;
    }
}

void push(int v, int tl, int tr) {
    if (tree[v].lazy != 0 && tl != tr) {
        int color = tree[v].lazy;
        tree[2*v].lazy = color;
        tree[2*v].mask = 1ULL << (color - 1);
        tree[2*v+1].lazy = color;
        tree[2*v+1].mask = 1ULL << (color - 1);
        tree[v].lazy = 0;
    }
}

void update(int v, int tl, int tr, int l, int r, int color) {
    if (l > r) return;
    if (tl == l && tr == r) {
        tree[v].lazy = color;
        tree[v].mask = 1ULL << (color - 1);
    } else {
        push(v, tl, tr);
        int tm = (tl + tr) / 2;
        update(2*v, tl, tm, l, min(r, tm), color);
        update(2*v+1, tm+1, tr, max(l, tm+1), r, color);
        tree[v].mask = tree[2*v].mask | tree[2*v+1].mask;
    }
}

uint64_t query(int v, int tl, int tr, int l, int r) {
    if (l > r) return 0;
    if (tl == l && tr == r) {
        return tree[v].mask;
    }
    push(v, tl, tr);
    int tm = (tl + tr) / 2;
    return query(2*v, tl, tm, l, min(r, tm)) | 
           query(2*v+1, tm+1, tr, max(l, tm+1), r);
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        cin >> c[i];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n-1; ++i) {
        int x, y;
        cin >> x >> y;
        adj[x].push_back(y);
        adj[y].push_back(x);
    }
    dfs(1, -1);
    for (int u = 1; u <= n; ++u) {
        color_array[tin[u]] = c[u];
    }
    build(1, 1, n);
    while (m--) {
        int t;
        cin >> t;
        if (t == 1) {
            int v, color;
            cin >> v >> color;
            update(1, 1, n, tin[v], tout[v], color);
        } else {
            int v;
            cin >> v;
            uint64_t mask = query(1, 1, n, tin[v], tout[v]);
            cout << __builtin_popcountll(mask) << '\n';
        }
    }
    return 0;

#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <stack>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;

struct SegmentTree {
    int size;
    vector<int> tree;
    vector<int> lazy;

    SegmentTree(int n) {
        size = 1;
        while (size < n) size <<= 1;
        tree.assign(2 * size, 0);
        lazy.assign(2 * size, 0);
    }

    void push(int node, int l, int r) {
        if (lazy[node] == 0) return;
        tree[node] = max(tree[node], lazy[node]);
        if (l != r) {
            lazy[2*node] = max(lazy[2*node], lazy[node]);
            lazy[2*node+1] = max(lazy[2*node+1], lazy[node]);
        }
        lazy[node] = 0;
    }

    void range_update(int a, int b, int val, int node, int l, int r) {
        push(node, l, r);
        if (b < l || a > r) return;
        if (a <= l && r <= b) {
            lazy[node] = max(lazy[node], val);
            push(node, l, r);
            return;
        }
        int mid = (l + r) / 2;
        range_update(a, b, val, 2*node, l, mid);
        range_update(a, b, val, 2*node+1, mid+1, r);
        tree[node] = max(tree[2*node], tree[2*node+1]);
    }

    void range_update(int a, int b, int val) {
        range_update(a, b, val, 1, 0, size-1);
    }

    int query(int pos, int node, int l, int r) {
        push(node, l, r);
        if (l == r) return tree[node];
        int mid = (l + r)/2;
        if (pos <= mid) return query(pos, 2*node, l, mid);
        else return query(pos, 2*node+1, mid+1, r);
    }

    int query(int pos) {
        return query(pos, 1, 0, size-1);
    }
};

vector<int> build_suffix_array(const string &s) {
    int n = s.size();
    vector<int> sa(n), rank(n), new_rank(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        sa[i] = i;
        rank[i] = s[i];
    }
    for (int k = 1; k < n; k <<= 1) {
        auto cmp = [&](int a, int b) {
            if (rank[a] != rank[b]) return rank[a] < rank[b];
            int ra = (a + k < n) ? rank[a + k] : -1;
            int rb = (b + k < n) ? rank[b + k] : -1;
            return ra < rb;
        };
        sort(sa.begin(), sa.end(), cmp);
        new_rank[sa[0]] = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++)
            new_rank[sa[i]] = new_rank[sa[i-1]] + cmp(sa[i-1], sa[i]);
        rank.swap(new_rank);
    }
    return sa;
}

vector<int> build_lcp(const string &s, const vector<int> &sa) {
    int n = s.size();
    vector<int> lcp(n-1), rank(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) rank[sa[i]] = i;
    int h = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (rank[i] == 0) continue;
        int j = sa[rank[i]-1];
        while (i + h < n && j + h < n && s[i+h] == s[j+h]) h++;
        lcp[rank[i]-1] = h;
        if (h > 0) h--;
    }
    return lcp;
}

vector<int> prev_smaller(const vector<int> &v) {
    int n = v.size();
    vector<int> res(n, -1);
    stack<int> s;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        while (!s.empty() && v[s.top()] >= v[i]) s.pop();
        if (!s.empty()) res[i] = s.top();
        s.push(i);
    }
    return res;
}

vector<int> next_smaller(const vector<int> &v) {
    int n = v.size();
    vector<int> res(n, n);
    stack<int> s;
    for (int i = n-1; i >= 0; i--) {
        while (!s.empty() && v[s.top()] >= v[i]) s.pop();
        if (!s.empty()) res[i] = s.top();
        s.push(i);
    }
    return res;
}

void solve() {
    int L, H;
    while (cin >> L >> H, L || H) {
        string s;
        cin >> s;
        int n = s.size();
        if (n == 0) {
            cout << "0 0\n";
            continue;
        }

        auto sa = build_suffix_array(s);
        auto lcp = build_lcp(s, sa);
        int m = lcp.size();

        vector<pair<int, int>> intervals;
        auto ps = prev_smaller(lcp);
        auto ns = next_smaller(lcp);

        int max_m_val = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int width = ns[i] - ps[i] - 1;
            int m_val = lcp[i];
            if (m_val <= 0) continue;
            intervals.emplace_back(m_val, width);
            max_m_val = max(max_m_val, m_val);
        }

        sort(intervals.begin(), intervals.end(), greater<pair<int, int>>());

        SegmentTree st(max_m_val + 2);

        for (auto &[m_val, width] : intervals) {
            st.range_update(1, m_val, width);
        }

        int max_count = 0;
        int best_len = 0;

        int start = max(L, 1);
        int end = min(H, n);

        for (int k = start; k <= end; k++) {
            int current_count = 0;
            if (k == n) {
                current_count = 1;
            } else {
                if (k > max_m_val) {
                    current_count = 0;
                } else {
                    current_count = st.query(k);
                }
                current_count += 1;
            }

            if (current_count > max_count || (current_count == max_count && k > best_len)) {
                max_count = current_count;
                best_len = k;
            }
        }

        if (max_count == 0) {
            cout << "0 0\n";
        } else {
            cout << max_count << " " << best_len << "\n";
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    solve();
    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

void solve() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<int> p(n);
    for (auto &x : p) cin >> x;

    vector<int> max_right_end(n + 2, 0), max_right_j(n + 2, 0);
    for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
        int start = j + 1;
        int end = j + p[j - 1];
        end = min(end, n);
        if (start > end) continue;
        if (end > max_right_end[start]) {
            max_right_end[start] = end;
            max_right_j[start] = j;
        }
    }
    int current_max_end = 0, current_max_j = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        if (max_right_end[i] > current_max_end) {
            current_max_end = max_right_end[i];
            current_max_j = max_right_j[i];
        } else {
            max_right_end[i] = current_max_end;
            max_right_j[i] = current_max_j;
        }
    }

    vector<int> max_left_end(n + 2, 0), max_left_j(n + 2, 0);
    for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
        int start = j - p[j - 1];
        start = max(start, 1);
        int end = j - 1;
        if (start > end) continue;
        if (end > max_left_end[start]) {
            max_left_end[start] = end;
            max_left_j[start] = j;
        }
    }
    current_max_end = 0, current_max_j = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        if (max_left_end[i] > current_max_end) {
            current_max_end = max_left_end[i];
            current_max_j = max_left_j[i];
        } else {
            max_left_end[i] = current_max_end;
            max_left_j[i] = current_max_j;
        }
    }

    vector<char> directions(n, 'L');
    int current = 1;
    bool possible = true;
    while (current <= n) {
        int right_end = max_right_end[current];
        int right_j = max_right_j[current];
        int left_end = max_left_end[current];
        int left_j = max_left_j[current];
        if (right_end == 0 && left_end == 0) {
            possible = false;
            break;
        }
        if (max(right_end, left_end) < current) {
            possible = false;
            break;
        }
        if (right_end > left_end) {
            directions[right_j - 1] = 'R';
            current = right_end + 1;
        } else {
            directions[left_j - 1] = 'L';
            current = left_end + 1;
        }
    }
    if (!possible) {
        cout << "NO\n";
    } else {
        cout << "YES\n";
        cout << string(directions.begin(), directions.end()) << '\n';
    }
}

        solve();

#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <queue>
#include <set>
#include <map>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

int compare(const string &a, const string &b) {
    if (a.size() != b.size()) return a.size() > b.size() ? 1 : -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); ++i) {
        if (a[i] != b[i]) return a[i] > b[i] ? 1 : -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

string multiply(const string &num, int factor) {
    if (num == "0" || factor == 0) return "0";
    string res;
    int carry = 0;
    for (int i = num.size() - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
        int digit = num[i] - '0';
        int product = digit * factor + carry;
        res.push_back(product % 10 + '0');
        carry = product / 10;
    }
    while (carry > 0) {
        res.push_back(carry % 10 + '0');
        carry /= 10;
    }
    reverse(res.begin(), res.end());
    size_t start = res.find_first_not_of('0');
    return start == string::npos ? "0" : res.substr(start);
}

string subtract(const string &a, const string &b) {
    if (compare(a, b) < 0) return "";
    string a_rev = a, b_rev = b;
    reverse(a_rev.begin(), a_rev.end());
    reverse(b_rev.begin(), b_rev.end());
    string res;
    int borrow = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < a_rev.size(); ++i) {
        int digit_a = a_rev[i] - '0' - borrow;
        int digit_b = i < b_rev.size() ? b_rev[i] - '0' : 0;
        borrow = 0;
        if (digit_a < digit_b) {
            digit_a += 10;
            borrow = 1;
        }
        res.push_back(digit_a - digit_b + '0');
    }
    reverse(res.begin(), res.end());
    size_t start = res.find_first_not_of('0');
    return start == string::npos ? "0" : res.substr(start);
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using ll = long long;
const ll INF = LLONG_MAX;

struct DSU {
    vector<int> parent, rank;
    DSU(int n) : parent(n+1), rank(n+1, 1) {
        iota(parent.begin(), parent.end(), 0);
    }
    int find(int u) {
        if (parent[u] != u) parent[u] = find(parent[u]);
        return parent[u];
    }
    bool unite(int u, int v) {
        u = find(u), v = find(v);
        if (u == v) return false;
        if (rank[u] < rank[v]) swap(u, v);
        parent[v] = u;
        rank[u] += rank[v];
        return true;
    }
};

struct LCA {
    int n, LOG;
    vector<int> depth;
    vector<ll> dist_root;
    vector<vector<int>> up;

    LCA(int _n, const vector<vector<pair<int, int>>>& adj, int root) : n(_n), LOG(20), depth(n+1), dist_root(n+1), up(LOG, vector<int>(n+1)) {
        vector<int> parent(n+1, -1);
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(root);
        parent[root] = root;
        dist_root[root] = 0;
        depth[root] = 0;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front();
            q.pop();
            for (auto [v, d] : adj[u]) {
                if (parent[v] == -1) {
                    parent[v] = u;
                    depth[v] = depth[u] + 1;
                    dist_root[v] = dist_root[u] + d;
                    q.push(v);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int u = 1; u <= n; ++u) up[0][u] = parent[u];
        for (int k = 1; k < LOG; ++k)
            for (int u = 1; u <= n; ++u)
                up[k][u] = up[k-1][up[k-1][u]];
    }

    int lca(int u, int v) {
        if (depth[u] < depth[v]) swap(u, v);
        for (int k = LOG-1; k >=0; --k)
            if (depth[u] - (1 << k) >= depth[v])
                u = up[k][u];
        if (u == v) return u;
        for (int k = LOG-1; k >=0; --k)
            if (up[k][u] != up[k][v])
                u = up[k][u], v = up[k][v];
        return up[0][u];
    }

    ll distance(int u, int v) {
        int anc = lca(u, v);
        return dist_root[u] + dist_root[v] - 2 * dist_root[anc];
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    vector<tuple<int, int, int>> edges;
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int u, v, d;
        cin >> u >> v >> d;
        edges.emplace_back(u, v, d);
    }

    DSU dsu(n);
    vector<tuple<int, int, int>> tree_edges, non_tree_edges;
    for (auto [u, v, d] : edges) {
        if (dsu.unite(u, v)) {
            tree_edges.emplace_back(u, v, d);
        } else {
            non_tree_edges.emplace_back(u, v, d);
        }
    }

    vector<vector<pair<int, int>>> tree_adj(n+1);
    for (auto [u, v, d] : tree_edges) {
        tree_adj[u].emplace_back(v, d);
        tree_adj[v].emplace_back(u, d);
    }

    LCA lca_solver(n, tree_adj, 1);

    unordered_set<int> S;
    for (auto [u, v, d] : non_tree_edges) {
        S.insert(u);
        S.insert(v);
    }

    vector<int> S_list(S.begin(), S.end());
    int s_cnt = S_list.size();

    vector<vector<pair<int, int>>> original_adj(n+1);
    for (auto [u, v, d] : edges) {
        original_adj[u].emplace_back(v, d);
        original_adj[v].emplace_back(u, d);
    }

    vector<vector<ll>> dist_S(s_cnt, vector<ll>(n+1, INF));
    for (int i = 0; i < s_cnt; ++i) {
        int s = S_list[i];
        priority_queue<pair<ll, int>, vector<pair<ll, int>>, greater<>> pq;
        dist_S[i][s] = 0;
        pq.emplace(0, s);
        while (!pq.empty()) {
            auto [d, u] = pq.top();
            pq.pop();
            if (d > dist_S[i][u]) continue;
            for (auto [v, w] : original_adj[u]) {
                if (dist_S[i][v] > d + w) {
                    dist_S[i][v] = d + w;
                    pq.emplace(dist_S[i][v], v);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    int q;
    cin >> q;
    while (q--) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        ll tree_dist = lca_solver.distance(u, v);
        if (s_cnt == 0) {
            cout << tree_dist << '\n';
            continue;
        }
        ll min_extra = INF;
        for (int i = 0; i < s_cnt; ++i) {
            if (dist_S[i][u] != INF && dist_S[i][v] != INF)
                min_extra = min(min_extra, dist_S[i][u] + dist_S[i][v]);
        }
        cout << min(tree_dist, min_extra) << '\n';
    }

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

struct Edge {
    int to, rev;
    ll cap;
    Edge(int to, int rev, ll cap) : to(to), rev(rev), cap(cap) {}
};

class Dinic {
public:
    vector<vector<Edge>> adj;
    vector<int> level, ptr;
    int n, s, t;

    Dinic(int n, int s, int t) : n(n), s(s), t(t) {
        adj.resize(n+1);
    }

    void add_edge(int u, int v, ll cap) {
        adj[u].emplace_back(v, adj[v].size(), cap);
        adj[v].emplace_back(u, adj[u].size() - 1, 0);
    }

    bool bfs() {
        level.assign(n+1, -1);
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(s);
        level[s] = 0;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front();
            q.pop();
            for (auto &e : adj[u]) {
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                    level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.push(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[t] != -1;
    }

    ll dfs(int u, ll flow) {
        if (u == t)
            return flow;
        for (int &i = ptr[u]; i < adj[u].size(); i++) {
            Edge &e = adj[u][i];
            if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == level[u] + 1) {
                ll min_flow = min(flow, e.cap);
                ll pushed = dfs(e.to, min_flow);
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.cap -= pushed;
                    adj[e.to][e.rev].cap += pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    ll max_flow() {
        ll flow = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            ptr.assign(n+1, 0);
            while (ll pushed = dfs(s, LLONG_MAX)) {
                flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    vector<bool> min_cut() {
        vector<bool> reachable(n+1, false);
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(s);
        reachable[s] = true;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front();
            q.pop();
            for (auto &e : adj[u]) {
                if (e.cap > 0 && !reachable[e.to]) {
                    reachable[e.to] = true;
                    q.push(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return reachable;
    }
};

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

vector<int> bfs(int start, const vector<vector<int>>& adj, vector<int>& parent) {
    int n = adj.size();
    vector<int> dist(n, -1);
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(start);
    dist[start] = 0;
    parent[start] = -1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int v : adj[u]) {
            if (dist[v] == -1) {
                dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                parent[v] = u;
                q.push(v);
            }
        }
    }
    return dist;
}

pair<int, vector<int>> find_diameter(const vector<vector<int>>& adj) {
    int n = adj.size();
    vector<int> parent(n, -1);
    vector<int> dist1 = bfs(0, adj, parent);
    int u = max_element(dist1.begin(), dist1.end()) - dist1.begin();
    dist1 = bfs(u, adj, parent);
    int v = max_element(dist1.begin(), dist1.end()) - dist1.begin();
    vector<int> path;
    for (int cur = v; cur != -1; cur = parent[cur]) {
        path.push_back(cur);
    }
    reverse(path.begin(), path.end());
    return {path.size() - 1, path};
}

vector<int> get_centers(const vector<int>& path) {
    int d = path.size() - 1;
    vector<int> centers;
    if (d % 2 == 0) {
        centers.push_back(path[d / 2]);
    } else {
        centers.push_back(path[(d-1)/2]);
        centers.push_back(path[(d+1)/2]);
    }
    return centers;
}

bool process_root(int root, const vector<vector<int>>& adj, int& sum_pairs) {
    int n = adj.size();
    vector<tuple<int, int, int, int, vector<int>>> stack;
    vector<int> parent(n, -1);
    vector<int> visited(n, 0);
    vector<int> sum(n, 0);
    vector<int> chain(n, 0);

    stack.emplace_back(root, -1, 0, 0, vector<int>{});

    while (!stack.empty()) {
        auto [u, p, state, idx, children] = stack.back();
        stack.pop_back();

        if (state == 0) {
            // First visit, push back with state 1 and process children
            visited[u] = 1;
            parent[u] = p;
            vector<int> children_list;
            for (int v : adj[u]) {
                if (v != p) {
                    children_list.push_back(v);
                }
            }
            if (children_list.empty()) {
                sum[u] = 0;
                chain[u] = 0;
            } else {
                stack.emplace_back(u, p, 1, 0, children_list);
                for (auto it = children_list.rbegin(); it != children_list.rend(); ++it) {
                    stack.emplace_back(*it, u, 0, 0, vector<int>{});
                }
            }
        } else {
            // Process children
            sum[u] = 0;
            vector<int> chain_children;
            for (int v : children) {
                sum[u] += sum[v];
                chain_children.push_back(chain[v] + 1);
            }

            unordered_map<int, int> freq;
            for (int l : chain_children) {
                freq[l]++;
            }

            int current_sum = 0;
            int max_unpaired = -1;
            int unpaired_count = 0;

            for (auto& [l, cnt] : freq) {
                int pairs = cnt / 2;
                current_sum += pairs * l;
                if (cnt % 2 != 0) {
                    unpaired_count++;
                    max_unpaired = max(max_unpaired, l);
                }
            }

            if (unpaired_count > 1) {
                return false;
            }

            sum[u] += current_sum;
            chain[u] = (max_unpaired == -1) ? 0 : max_unpaired;
        }
    }

    sum_pairs = sum[root];
    return true;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<vector<int>> adj(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n-1; ++i) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        u--; v--;
        adj[u].push_back(v);
        adj[v].push_back(u);
    }

    auto [diameter_len, path] = find_diameter(adj);
    vector<int> centers = get_centers(path);

    int max_sum = -1;
    bool possible = false;

    for (int center : centers) {
        int sum_pairs;
        if (process_root(center, adj, sum_pairs)) {
            possible = true;
            max_sum = max(max_sum, sum_pairs);
        }
    }

    if (possible) {
        cout << (n-1 - max_sum) << endl;
    } else {
        cout << -1 << endl;
    }

    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int u, v;
    char c;
};

pair<int, vector<int>> solve_for_target(int n, const vector<Edge>& edges, char target) {
    vector<vector<pair<int, int>>> adj(n + 1);
    for (const auto& e : edges) {
        int t;
        if (target == 'R') {
            t = (e.c == 'B') ? 1 : 0;
        } else {
            t = (e.c == 'R') ? 1 : 0;
        }
        adj[e.u].emplace_back(e.v, t);
        adj[e.v].emplace_back(e.u, t);
    }

    vector<int> color(n + 1, -1);
    vector<int> flips;
    bool possible = true;

    for (int u = 1; u <= n; ++u) {
        if (color[u] == -1) {
            queue<int> q;
            q.push(u);
            color[u] = 0;
            vector<int> component_nodes = {u};
            bool conflict = false;

            while (!q.empty()) {
                int current = q.front();
                q.pop();

                for (const auto& neighbor : adj[current]) {
                    int v = neighbor.first;
                    int t = neighbor.second;
                    if (color[v] == -1) {
                        color[v] = color[current] ^ t;
                        component_nodes.push_back(v);
                        q.push(v);
                    } else if ((color[current] ^ t) != color[v]) {
                        conflict = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (conflict) break;
            }

            if (conflict) {
                possible = false;
                break;
            }

            int cnt0 = 0, cnt1 = 0;
            for (int node : component_nodes) {
                if (color[node] == 0) cnt0++;
                else cnt1++;
            }

            if (cnt0 <= cnt1) {
                for (int node : component_nodes)
                    if (color[node] == 0)
                        flips.push_back(node);
            } else {
                for (int node : component_nodes)
                    if (color[node] == 1)
                        flips.push_back(node);
            }
        }
    }

    if (!possible) return {-1, {}};
    return {flips.size(), flips};
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    vector<Edge> edges(m);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        cin >> edges[i].u >> edges[i].v >> edges[i].c;
    }

    auto res_r = solve_for_target(n, edges, 'R');
    auto res_b = solve_for_target(n, edges, 'B');

    int best_k = INT_MAX;
    vector<int> best_flips;

    if (res_r.first != -1) {
        best_k = res_r.first;
        best_flips = res_r.second;
    }
    if (res_b.first != -1 && res_b.first < best_k) {
        best_k = res_b.first;
        best_flips = res_b.second;
    }

    if (best_k == INT_MAX) {
        cout << "-1\n";
    } else {
        cout << best_k << '\n';
        for (int node : best_flips) {
            cout << node << ' ';
        }
        if (best_k > 0) cout << '\n';
    }

    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Node {
    int start, end;
    bool same;
    char l_char, r_char;
    int cnt[10][10] = {{0}};
    char lazy = 0;
    Node *left = nullptr, *right = nullptr;

    Node(int s, int e) : start(s), end(e) {}
};

void applyLazy(Node* node, char c) {
    if (!node || node->lazy == c) return;
    node->lazy = c;
    node->same = true;
    node->l_char = c;
    node->r_char = c;
    memset(node->cnt, 0, sizeof(node->cnt));
    int len = node->end - node->start;
    if (len > 0) {
        node->cnt[c - 'a'][c - 'a'] = len;
    }
    if (node->left) {
        delete node->left;
        node->left = nullptr;
    }
    if (node->right) {
        delete node->right;
        node->right = nullptr;
    }
}

void merge(Node* node) {
    if (!node->left || !node->right) return;
    if (node->left->same && node->right->same && node->left->l_char == node->right->l_char) {
        node->same = true;
        node->l_char = node->left->l_char;
        node->r_char = node->left->l_char;
        memset(node->cnt, 0, sizeof(node->cnt));
        int len = node->end - node->start;
        if (len > 0) {
            node->cnt[node->l_char - 'a'][node->l_char - 'a'] = len;
        }
    } else {
        node->same = false;
        node->l_char = node->left->l_char;
        node->r_char = node->right->r_char;
        for (int a = 0; a < 10; ++a)
            for (int b = 0; b < 10; ++b)
                node->cnt[a][b] = node->left->cnt[a][b] + node->right->cnt[a][b];
        char a = node->left->r_char;
        char b = node->right->l_char;
        node->cnt[a - 'a'][b - 'a'] += 1;
    }
}

void updateRange(Node* node, int l, int r, char c) {
    if (node->end < l || node->start > r) return;
    if (l <= node->start && node->end <= r) {
        applyLazy(node, c);
        return;
    }
    if (node->lazy != 0) {
        if (!node->left || !node->right) {
            int mid = (node->start + node->end) / 2;
            node->left = new Node(node->start, mid);
            node->right = new Node(mid + 1, node->end);
            applyLazy(node->left, node->lazy);
            applyLazy(node->right, node->lazy);
        } else {
            applyLazy(node->left, node->lazy);
            applyLazy(node->right, node->lazy);
        }
        node->lazy = 0;
    }
    updateRange(node->left, l, r, c);
    updateRange(node->right, l, r, c);
    merge(node);
}

Node* build(int start, int end, const string& s) {
    Node* node = new Node(start, end);
    if (start == end) {
        node->l_char = s[start - 1];
        node->r_char = s[start - 1];
        node->same = true;
        return node;
    }
    int mid = (start + end) / 2;
    node->left = build(start, mid, s);
    node->right = build(mid + 1, end, s);
    merge(node);
    return node;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m, k;
    cin >> n >> m >> k;
    string s;
    cin >> s;

    Node* root = build(1, n, s);

    while (m--) {
        int op;
        cin >> op;
        if (op == 1) {
            int l, r;
            char c;
            cin >> l >> r >> c;
            updateRange(root, l, r, c);

            vector<int> pos(k);
            for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i)
                pos[p[i] - 'a'] = i;
            int total = 0;
            for (int a = 0; a < k; ++a)
                for (int b = 0; b < k; ++b)
                    if (pos[a] >= pos[b])
                        total += root->cnt[a][b];
            cout << total + 1 << '\n';
        }
    }

    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>

using namespace std;

typedef uint64_t ull;

const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;
const int MAXN = 1e5 + 5;

vector<pair<int, ull>> adj[MAXN];
bool visited[MAXN];
ull base_xor[MAXN];
vector<ull> pow2(61, 1);

int main() {
    // Precompute powers of 2 modulo MOD
    for (int i = 1; i <= 60; ++i) {
        pow2[i] = (pow2[i - 1] * 2) % MOD;
    }

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    // Build adjacency list
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int u, v;
        ull t;
        cin >> u >> v >> t;
        adj[u].emplace_back(v, t);
        adj[v].emplace_back(u, t);
    }

    ull total = 0;
    const ull inv2 = (MOD + 1) / 2; // 500000004

    fill(visited, visited + n + 1, false);

    for (int start = 1; start <= n; ++start) {
        if (visited[start]) continue;

        vector<int> component;
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(start);
        visited[start] = true;
        base_xor[start] = 0;
        unordered_map<int, int> parent;
        parent[start] = -1;
        vector<ull> cycle_values;

        // BFS to find component and collect cycle values
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front();
            q.pop();
            component.push_back(u);

            for (auto [v, t] : adj[u]) {
                if (!visited[v]) {
                    visited[v] = true;
                    base_xor[v] = base_xor[u] ^ t;
                    parent[v] = u;
                    q.push(v);
                } else if (v != parent[u]) {
                    // Back edge, add cycle value
                    ull cycle_val = base_xor[u] ^ base_xor[v] ^ t;
                    cycle_values.push_back(cycle_val);
                }
            }
        }

        // Build linear basis
        vector<ull> basis(64, 0);
        for (ull x : cycle_values) {
            ull current = x;
            for (int i = 60; i >= 0; --i) {
                if ((current >> i) & 1) {
                    if (basis[i]) {
                        current ^= basis[i];
                    } else {
                        basis[i] = current;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Compute B and r
        ull B = 0;
        int r = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 60; ++i) {
            if (basis[i]) {
                B |= basis[i];
                r++;
            }
        }

        // Compute mask
        ull mask = ~B;

        // Collect a_i for all nodes in the component
        vector<ull> a_list;
        for (int u : component) {
            a_list.push_back(base_xor[u] & mask);
        }

        // Calculate sum_part2
        ull sum_part2 = 0;
        int k = component.size();

        for (int b = 0; b <= 60; ++b) {
            if (!(mask & (1ULL << b))) continue;

            int cnt = 0;
            for (ull a : a_list) {
                if ((a >> b) & 1) cnt++;
            }

            int c0 = (k - cnt) % MOD;
            int c1 = cnt % MOD;
            ull term = (1ULL * c0 * c1) % MOD;
            term = (term * pow2[b]) % MOD;
            sum_part2 = (sum_part2 + term) % MOD;
        }

        // Compute part1 and part2
        ull pow2_r = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < r; ++i) {
            pow2_r = (pow2_r * 2) % MOD;
        }
        ull pow2_r_1 = (pow2_r * inv2) % MOD;

        ull k_choose_2 = (1ULL * k * (k - 1) / 2) % MOD;
        ull part1 = ((B % MOD) * k_choose_2 % MOD) * pow2_r_1 % MOD;
        ull part2 = (sum_part2 * pow2_r) % MOD;

        total = (total + part1 + part2) % MOD;
    }

    cout << total << endl;

    return 0;
}<#sep#>-

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int compute_size_u(const vector<unordered_set<int>>& adj, const unordered_set<int>& T, int u, int v) {
    unordered_set<int> visited;
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(u);
    visited.insert(u);
    int count = 0;

    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        count++;
        for (int y : adj[x]) {
            if (!T.count(y)) continue;
            if ((x == u && y == v) || (x == v && y == u)) continue;
            if (!visited.count(y)) {
                visited.insert(y);
                q.push(y);
            }
        }
    }
    return count;
}

unordered_set<int> get_new_T(const vector<unordered_set<int>>& adj, const unordered_set<int>& current_T, int a, int u_edge, int v_edge) {
    unordered_set<int> new_T;
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(a);
    new_T.insert(a);

    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int y : adj[x]) {
            if (!current_T.count(y)) continue;
            if ((x == u_edge && y == v_edge) || (x == v_edge && y == u_edge)) continue;
            if (!new_T.count(y)) {
                new_T.insert(y);
                q.push(y);
            }
        }
    }

    return new_T;
}

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;

    vector<unordered_set<int>> adj(n + 1);
    vector<pair<int, int>> edges;

    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        adj[u].insert(v);
        adj[v].insert(u);
        edges.emplace_back(u, v);
    }

    unordered_set<int> current_T;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) current_T.insert(i);

    while (current_T.size() > 1) {
        vector<pair<int, int>> possible_edges;
        for (auto& e : edges) {
            int u = e.first, v = e.second;
            if (current_T.count(u) && current_T.count(v)) {
                possible_edges.push_back(e);
            }
        }

        pair<int, int> best_edge;
        int min_max = n + 1;

        for (auto& e : possible_edges) {
            int u = e.first, v = e.second;
            int size_u = compute_size_u(adj, current_T, u, v);
            int max_size = max(size_u, (int)current_T.size() - size_u);
            if (max_size < min_max) {
                min_max = max_size;
                best_edge = e;
            } else if (max_size == min_max && best_edge == pair<int, int>{0, 0}) {
                best_edge = e;
            }
        }

        int u = best_edge.first, v = best_edge.second;
        cout << "? " << u << " " << v << endl;
        cout.flush();

        int a;
        cin >> a;

        current_T = get_new_T(adj, current_T, a, u, v);
    }

    cout << "! " << *current_T.begin() << endl;
    cout.flush();

    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct LinkCutTree {
    struct Node {
        int sz, label;
        Node *p, *pp, *c[2];
        bool flip;
        int depth, virtual_depth;
        Node() : sz(1), label(0), p(nullptr), pp(nullptr), flip(false), depth(0), virtual_depth(0) {
            c[0] = c[1] = nullptr;
        }
        void update() {
            sz = 1;
            if (c[0]) sz += c[0]->sz;
            if (c[1]) sz += c[1]->sz;
        }
        void push() {
            if (flip) {
                swap(c[0], c[1]);
                if (c[0]) c[0]->flip ^= 1;
                if (c[1]) c[1]->flip ^= 1;
                flip = false;
            }
        }
    };

    vector<Node> nodes;

    LinkCutTree(int n) {
        nodes.resize(n + 1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) nodes[i].label = i;
    }

    void normalize(Node *u) {
        if (u->p) normalize(u->p);
        u->push();
    }

    void rotate(Node *u, int d) {
        Node *v = u->p;
        Node *w = u->c[d];
        if (v->c[d ^ 1] = w) w->p = v;
        u->c[d] = v;
        v->p = u;
        u->p = v->p;
        v->p = u;
        if (u->p) {
            if (u->p->c[0] == v) u->p->c[0] = u;
            else if (u->p->c[1] == v) u->p->c[1] = u;
        }
        v->update();
        u->update();
        swap(u->pp, v->pp);
    }

    void splay(Node *u) {
        normalize(u);
        while (u->p) {
            Node *v = u->p;
            if (!v->p) {
                v->push();
                u->push();
                rotate(u, v->c[0] == u);
            } else {
                Node *w = v->p;
                w->push();
                v->push();
                u->push();
                int d1 = w->c[1] == v;
                int d2 = v->c[1] == u;
                if (d1 == d2) {
                    rotate(v, d1);
                    rotate(u, d2);
                } else {
                    rotate(u, d2);
                    rotate(u, d1);
                }
            }
        }
        u->push();
    }

    Node *access(Node *u) {
        splay(u);
        if (u->c[1]) {
            u->c[1]->pp = u;
            u->c[1]->p = nullptr;
            u->c[1] = nullptr;
            u->update();
        }
        Node *v = u;
        while (u->pp) {
            v = u->pp;
            splay(v);
            if (v->c[1]) {
                v->c[1]->pp = v;
                v->c[1]->p = nullptr;
            }
            v->c[1] = u;
            u->p = v;
            u->pp = nullptr;
            v->update();
            splay(u);
        }
        return v;
    }

    void make_root(Node *u) {
        access(u);
        splay(u);
        u->flip ^= 1;
    }

    void link(Node *u, Node *v) {
        make_root(u);
        u->pp = v;
    }

    void cut(Node *u) {
        access(u);
        splay(u);
        if (u->c[0]) {
            u->c[0]->p = nullptr;
            u->c[0] = nullptr;
            u->update();
        }
    }

    Node *lca(Node *u, Node *v) {
        if (u == v) return u;
        access(u);
        access(v);
        splay(u);
        if (!u->pp) return nullptr;
        return u->pp;
    }

    int depth(Node *u) {
        access(u);
        splay(u);
        return u->sz - 1;
    }

    Node *ancestor(Node *u, int h) {
        access(u);
        splay(u);
        h = depth(u) - h;
        if (h < 0) return nullptr;
        while (true) {
            u->push();
            if (u->c[0] && u->c[0]->sz > h) u = u->c[0];
            else {
                if (u->c[0]) h -= u->c[0]->sz;
                if (h == 0) {
                    splay(u);
                    return u;
                }
                h -= 1;
                u = u->c[1];
            }
        }
    }

    Node* get_node(int u) {
        return &nodes[u];
    }
};

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int to, rev;
    int cap, flow;
    Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) : to(to), rev(rev), cap(cap), flow(0) {}
};

class Dinic {
public:
    vector<vector<Edge>> graph;
    vector<int> level, ptr;
    int n;

    Dinic(int nodes) : graph(nodes), level(nodes), ptr(nodes), n(nodes) {}

    void add_edge(int from, int to, int cap) {
        graph[from].emplace_back(to, graph[to].size(), cap);
        graph[to].emplace_back(from, graph[from].size()-1, 0);
    }

    bool bfs(int s, int t) {
        fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
        queue<int> q;
        level[s] = 0;
        q.push(s);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front();
            q.pop();
            for (const Edge& e : graph[u]) {
                if (e.cap > e.flow && level[e.to] == -1) {
                    level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.push(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[t] != -1;
    }

    int dfs(int u, int t, int flow) {
        if (u == t || flow == 0) return flow;
        for (int& i = ptr[u]; i < graph[u].size(); ++i) {
            Edge& e = graph[u][i];
            if (e.cap > e.flow && level[e.to] == level[u] + 1) {
                int pushed = dfs(e.to, t, min(flow, e.cap - e.flow));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.flow += pushed;
                    graph[e.to][e.rev].flow -= pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    int max_flow(int s, int t) {
        int total = 0;
        while (bfs(s, t)) {
            fill(ptr.begin(), ptr.end(), 0);
            while (int pushed = dfs(s, t, INT_MAX)) {
                total += pushed;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    vector<int> a(n), b(n);
    for (int& x : a) cin >> x;
    for (int& x : b) cin >> x;

    int sum_a = accumulate(a.begin(), a.end(), 0);
    int sum_b = accumulate(b.begin(), b.end(), 0);
    if (sum_a != sum_b) {
        cout << "NO\n";
        return 0;
    }

    vector<unordered_set<int>> adj(n+1);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int u, v;

        adj[u].insert(v);
        adj[v].insert(u);
    }

    int source = 0;
    int sink = 2 * n + 1;
    Dinic dinic(total_nodes);

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        dinic.add_edge(source, i, a[i-1]);
    }

    for (int i = n+1; i <= 2*n; ++i) {
        int city = i - n;
        dinic.add_edge(i, sink, b[city-1]);

#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <numeric>
#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

vector<vector<int>> adj, adj_rev;
vector<bool> visited;
vector<int> order;

void dfs1(int v) {
    visited[v] = true;
    for (int u : adj[v])
        if (!visited[u])
            dfs1(u);
    order.push_back(v);
}

void dfs2(int v, vector<int>& component, vector<bool>& vis) {
    vis[v] = true;
    component.push_back(v);
    for (int u : adj_rev[v])
        if (!vis[u])
            dfs2(u, component, vis);
}

int main() {
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    adj.resize(n+1);
    adj_rev.resize(n+1);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int a, b;
        cin >> a >> b;
        adj[a].push_back(b);
        adj_rev[b].push_back(a);
    }

    visited.assign(n+1, false);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
        if (!visited[i])
            dfs1(i);

    reverse(order.begin(), order.end());
    vector<vector<int>> components;
    vector<bool> vis(n+1, false);
    for (int v : order) {
        if (!vis[v]) {
            vector<int> component;
            dfs2(v, component, vis);
            components.push_back(component);
        }
    }

    vector<int> component_gcds;
    for (auto& comp : components) {
        if (comp.size() == 1) {
            bool self_loop = false;
            for (int u : adj[comp[0]])
                if (u == comp[0]) {
                    self_loop = true;
                    break;
                }
            if (self_loop)
                component_gcds.push_back(1);
        } else {
            vector<bool> in_comp(n+1, false);
            for (int u : comp)
                in_comp[u] = true;
            vector<int> d(n+1, -1);
            queue<int> q;
            int start = comp[0];
            d[start] = 0;
            q.push(start);
            int current_gcd = 0;
            while (!q.empty()) {
                int u = q.front(); q.pop();
                for (int v : adj[u]) {
                    if (!in_comp[v]) continue;
                    int new_dist = d[u] + 1;
                    if (d[v] == -1) {
                        d[v] = new_dist;
                        q.push(v);
                    } else {
                        int delta = new_dist - d[v];
                        current_gcd = gcd(current_gcd, abs(delta));
                    }
                }
            }
            component_gcds.push_back(current_gcd);
        }
    }

    int overall_gcd = 0;
    for (int g : component_gcds)
        if (g != 0)
            overall_gcd = gcd(overall_gcd, g);
    cout << (overall_gcd ? overall_gcd : n) << endl;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MAXN = 3e5 + 10;
const int LOG = 20;

vector<int> adj[MAXN];
int up[LOG][MAXN];
int depth[MAXN];
string s;

void dfs(int u, int p) {
    up[0][u] = p;
    for (int i = 1; i < LOG; ++i) {
        up[i][u] = (up[i-1][u] == -1) ? -1 : up[i-1][up[i-1][u]];
    }
    for (int v : adj[u]) {
        if (v != p) {
            depth[v] = depth[u] + 1;
            dfs(v, p);
        }
    }
}

int lca(int u, int v) {
    if (depth[u] < depth[v]) swap(u, v);
    for (int i = LOG-1; i >= 0; --i) {
        if (depth[u] - (1 << i) >= depth[v]) {
            u = up[i][u];
        }
    }
    if (u == v) return u;
    for (int i = LOG-1; i >= 0; --i) {
        if (up[i][u] != up[i][v]) {
            u = up[i][u];
            v = up[i][v];
        }
    }
    return up[0][u];
}

int get_kth(int u, int k) {
    for (int i = 0; i < LOG; ++i) {
        if (k & (1 << i)) {
            u = up[i][u];
            if (u == -1) return -1;
        }
    }
    return u;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    cin >> s;
    for (int i = 0; i < n-1; ++i) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        adj[u].push_back(v);
        adj[v].push_back(u);
    }
    memset(up, -1, sizeof(up));
    depth[1] = 0;

    while (m--) {
        int a, b, c, d;
        cin >> a >> b >> c >> d;

        int up_len_ab = depth[a] - depth[l_ab] + 1;
        int down_len_ab = depth[b] - depth[l_ab];
        int len_ab = up_len_ab + down_len_ab;
        
        int l_cd = lca(c, d);
        int up_len_cd = depth[c] - depth[l_cd] + 1;
        int down_len_cd = depth[d] - depth[l_cd];
        int len_cd = up_len_cd + down_len_cd;
        
        int min_len = min(len_ab, len_cd);
        if (min_len == 0) {
            cout << "0\n";
            continue;
        }
        
        int low = 0, high = min_len - 1;
        int ans = min_len;
        while (low <= high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            int node_ab, node_cd;
            
            // Get character from path a-b at mid
            if (mid < up_len_ab) {
                node_ab = get_kth(a, mid);
            } else {
                int i = mid - up_len_ab;
                int target_depth = depth[l_ab] + 1 + i;
                int steps = depth[b] - target_depth;
                node_ab = get_kth(b, steps);
            }
            
            // Get character from path c-d at mid
            if (mid < up_len_cd) {
                node_cd = get_kth(c, mid);
            } else {
                int i = mid - up_len_cd;
                int target_depth = depth[l_cd] + 1 + i;
                int steps = depth[d] - target_depth;
                node_cd = get_kth(d, steps);
            }
            
            if (node_ab == -1 || node_cd == -1 || s[node_ab-1] != s[node_cd-1]) {
                ans = mid;
                high = mid - 1;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        cout << ans << '\n';
    }
    
    return 0;

#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace std;

int pow_mod(int a, int b, int mod) {
    int res = 1;
    a %= mod;
    while (b > 0) {
        if (b % 2 == 1) {
            res = (1LL * res * a) % mod;
        }
        a = (1LL * a * a) % mod;
        b /= 2;
    }
    return res;
}

int mod_inverse(int a, int p) {
    return pow_mod(a, p-2, p);
}

int determinant(vector<vector<int>> M, int p) {
    int k = M.size();
    int det = 1;
    int swap_count = 0;
    for (int col = 0; col < k; ++col) {
        int pivot_row = -1;
        for (int row = col; row < k; ++row) {
            if (M[row][col] != 0) {
                pivot_row = row;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (pivot_row == -1) {
            return 0;
        }
        if (pivot_row != col) {
            swap(M[col], M[pivot_row]);
            swap_count++;
        }
        int inv_pivot = mod_inverse(M[col][col], p);
        for (int row = col + 1; row < k; ++row) {
            if (M[row][col] == 0) continue;
            int factor = (1LL * M[row][col] * inv_pivot) % p;
            for (int j = col; j < k; ++j) {
                M[row][j] = (M[row][j] - (1LL * factor * M[col][j]) % p + p) % p;
            }
        }
        det = (1LL * det * M[col][col]) % p;
    }
    if (swap_count % 2 == 1) {
        det = (p - det) % p;
    }
    return det;
}

int main() {
    int n, m, p;
    scanf("%d %d %d", &n, &m, &p);
    
    vector<vector<int>> adj(n+1);
    vector<int> in_degree(n+1, 0);
    vector<int> out_degree(n+1, 0);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int a, b;
        scanf("%d %d", &a, &b);
        adj[a].push_back(b);
        in_degree[b]++;
        out_degree[a]++;
    }
    
    vector<int> sources, sinks;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        if (in_degree[i] == 0) {
            sources.push_back(i);
        }
        if (out_degree[i] == 0) {
            sinks.push_back(i);
        }
    }
    sort(sources.begin(), sources.end());
    sort(sinks.begin(), sinks.end());
    
    int k = sources.size();
    if (k == 0) {
        printf("0\n");
        return 0;
    }
    
    vector<int> top_order;
    vector<int> in_degree_copy = in_degree;
    queue<int> q;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        if (in_degree_copy[i] == 0) {
            q.push(i);
        }
    }
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front();
        q.pop();
        top_order.push_back(u);
        for (int v : adj[u]) {
            if (--in_degree_copy[v] == 0) {
                q.push(v);
            }
        }
    }
    
    vector<vector<int>> mat(k, vector<int>(k, 0));
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        int s = sources[i];
        vector<int> dp(n+1, 0);
        dp[s] = 1;
        for (int u : top_order) {
            if (dp[u] == 0) continue;
            for (int v : adj[u]) {
                dp[v] = (dp[v] + dp[u]) % p;
            }
        }
        for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
            mat[i][j] = dp[sinks[j]] % p;
        }
    }
    
    int det = determinant(mat, p);
    printf("%d\n", det);
    
    return 0;
}<#sep#>-

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
